items.titleEn: Renée: "We let them come back too easy"
items.summaryEn: Renée Slegers was disappointed in how we allowed London City Lionesses to get back into the game against us on Sunday.
bodyEn: Renée Slegers was disappointed in how we allowed London City Lionesses to get back into the game against us on Sunday.
Frida Maanum gave us the lead in the 10th minute, but Isobel Goodwin equalised just one minute later to push us back to square one.

"Frustrating, of course, to not get to win the three points," our head coach said. "It's two good teams going against each other. It was a short turnaround, but I think the players left everything on the pitch. We started well, we scored a very good goal. We let them come back into the game too easy. And then we spent more time than we usually do without the ball. Partly game plan, partly because they did it well and caused us problems.
"I think we created chances going forward enough to get more out of this game. Unfortunately, we couldn't finish those chances. Like I said, the players left everything on the pitch today for us."
It was Maanum's second goal in two games following Thursday's finish at Camp Nou against Barcelona, and she was setup well by Emily Fox and Alessia Russo on Sunday.

"Yes, a very good goal," Renée agreed. "Less makes a really good run. There's space centrally. I think both Foord and Frida are in the box. You can always count on them in the box. They always invest. So really good. Great work from Less to see the free player and great finish from Frida."
We played in front of our highest attendance of the season so far of 32,588 supporters in N5, and so the team were naturally desperate to get the three points across the line for our fans.

"Yes, it was a great atmosphere under the lights at the Emirates," Renée said. "The fans were taking us through the game. It felt really intense and energetic from the stands. Again, I'm saying this for the fifth time after an Emirates game. The fans were on our minds and we wanted to give the three points, which we couldn't do today."

Looking ahead to Thursday's UEFA Women's Champions League game against Lyon, which tickets are on general sale for, there's a lot to play for in our bid to finish among the top four in the league phase.
"Now we'll have to recover and look forward to the challenge with Lyon," Renée added.

items.titleZh: 雷娜：我们太轻易让对手扳平了
items.summaryZh: 主教练雷娜对周日未能战胜伦敦城雌狮感到失望。
bodyZh: 雷娜·斯勒格斯对我们在周日对阵伦敦城雌狮的比赛中如何让对手扳平比分感到失望。
弗里达·马努姆在第10分钟为我们取得领先，但伊索贝尔·古德温仅在一分钟后就扳平了比分，让一切回到原点。
“没能全取三分当然令人沮丧，”我们的主教练说道。“这是两支优秀球队之间的较量。这是一场间隔短的比赛，但我认为球员们在场上付出了全部。我们开局不错，打进了一个非常漂亮的进球。我们太轻易让对手回到比赛中了。然后我们无球的时间比平时要多。一部分是战术安排，一部分是因为对手表现出色并给我们制造了麻烦。”
“我认为我们创造了足够多的进攻机会，本可以从这场比赛中收获更多。遗憾的是，我们没能把握住这些机会。就像我说的，球员们今天为我们倾尽所有。”
这是马努姆继周四在诺坎普对阵巴塞罗那破门后，连续两场比赛打进的第二球，周日她的进球由艾米莉·福克斯和阿莱西亚·鲁索精妙策划。
“是的，一个非常漂亮的进球，”雷娜赞同道。“莱斯（鲁索）进行了一次非常棒的无球跑动。中路有空间。我认为福德和弗里达都在禁区内。你总是可以指望他们在禁区里的表现。他们总是全力投入。所以真的很棒。莱斯发现空位队友的视野很好，弗里达的射门也很精彩。”
我们在北伦敦迎来了本赛季迄今为止最高的32,588名球迷现场助威，因此球队自然极度渴望为球迷全取三分。
“是的，在酋长球场的灯光下气氛太棒了，”雷娜说道。“球迷们陪伴我们度过了整场比赛。看台上的气氛感觉非常激烈且充满能量。这已经是我在酋长球场比赛后第五次这么说了。球迷们一直都在我们心中，我们想要献上三分，但今天没能做到。”
展望周四对阵里昂的欧洲女足冠军联赛比赛，该场比赛门票已经全面开售，我们在力争跻身联赛阶段前四的道路上还有很多目标要去争取。
“现在我们需要恢复体能，并期待迎战里昂的挑战，”雷娜补充道。

items.titleEn: Foord reacts to London City frustrations
items.summaryEn: Caitlin Foord said we were frustrated to come away from Sunday's WSL encounter with London City Lionesses with just a point
bodyEn: Caitlin Foord said we were frustrated to come away from Sunday's Women's Super League encounter with London City Lionesses with just a point.
Frida Maanum gave us the lead early on only for Isobel Goodwin to equalise a minute later. Despite our 17 shots, nine of which were on target, we were unable to add a second.

"Obviously to draw here again at the Emirates, it's not what we want," Foord said said. "We want to win, we want to keep winning games, It’s unfortunate. We had a lot of chances but it just didn't go our way today."
"We got the goal, we had momentum and then it changed so quickly. So, we're very disappointed with that and quite frustrated. But we had plenty of chances after that as well to go back in front."
We found the breakthrough when Emily Fox drove forward with the ball, found Alessia Russo and she pulled it back for Maanum to finish.

"That was a great goal," Foord reflected. "It was an Arsenal goal. As I said, we got a lot of momentum from that because it was such an Arsenal goal and a nice goal. But to concede again so quickly, it's frustrating."

Asked for her message to the 32,588 supporters who were in attendance at Emirates Stadium, Foord added: "They were so loud and they've stuck with us throughout every single game, home and away. So, we're disappointed not to be able to get the win for them today here."
Looking ahead, we return to UEFA Women's Champions League action on Thursday, with plenty to play for in our 8pm kick-off against Lyon, which tickets are on general sale for.

"It's a massive game on Thursday," Foord said. "Obviously, we'll turn to that now. They're a tough opponent, back at Borehamwood. But we obviously want to get the win and secure Champions League play-offs in a good position going into the last game."

items.titleZh: 福德谈对阵伦敦城时的沮丧情绪
items.summaryZh: 凯特琳·福德表示，阿森纳在对阵伦敦城母狮的英超比赛中仅取一分令人感到沮丧。
bodyZh: 凯特琳·福德表示，周日对阵伦敦城母狮的女足英超比赛最终只拿到一分，大家感到非常沮丧。
弗里达·马努姆早早为主队取得领先，但伊索贝尔·古德温在一分钟后就扳平了比分。尽管我们完成了17次射门且有9次射正，但未能打进第二球。
“显然，再次在酋长球场战平并不是我们想要的，”福德说。“我们想要赢球，我们想不断赢得比赛，这很不幸。我们创造了很多机会，但今天结果就是不如人意。”
“我们取得了进球，当时正处于势头上，但局势转变太快了。因此，我们对此感到非常失望和沮丧。但在那之后，我们其实还有很多再次领先的机会。”
我们通过埃米莉·福克斯带球向前寻找阿莱西亚·鲁索，随后鲁索回传助攻马努姆完成破门，从而打破了僵局。
“那是一个极棒的进球，”福德回忆道。“这是一个典型的阿森纳式进球。正如我所说，那个进球让我们士气大振，因为那是标准的阿森纳配合和精彩进球。但这么快又丢球，确实令人沮丧。”
当被问及对现场32,588名球迷想说些什么时，福德补充道：“他们的声音非常响亮，无论主场还是客场，每一场比赛都一直支持着我们。因此，今天没能在这里为他们赢得胜利，我们感到很失望。”
展望未来，我们将于周四重返欧洲女足冠军联赛赛场，这场将于晚上8点对阵里昂的比赛悬念重重，门票目前正在公开售票中。
“周四将是一场极其重要的比赛，”福德说道。“显然，我们将立刻把重心转移到那上面。他们是个强劲的对手，比赛将在博勒姆伍德进行。但我们显然想要取胜，并为以良好的排名进入最后一场比赛、锁定欧冠附加赛资格做好准备。”

items.titleEn: Report: Arsenal Women 1-1 London City Lionesses
items.summaryEn: We were held to a 1-1 draw by London City Lionesses in the Women’s Super League at Emirates Stadium on Sunday afternoon.
bodyEn: We were held to a 1-1 draw by London City Lionesses in the Women’s Super League at Emirates Stadium on Sunday afternoon.
Frida Maanum opened the scoring early on with her second goal in two games after Thursday’s strike away to Barcelona, but Isobel Goodwin equalised for the visitors just a minute later.
LIVELY START

Maanum brought us forward on the counter-attack and went out right to Lisa Baum, who turned inside and found Emily Fox, her effort deflected wide of bottom left as we had the first chance of the game.

Baum then layed it off for Ona Batlle who fired just wide of the bottom left from the edge of the area with a curling first-time strike, before we took the lead as Fox drove us forward and put perfect weight on her pass ahead to Alessia Russo, who pulled it back for Maanum to nestle into the back of the net for 1-0.
Our lead was short-lived, however, as Goodwin found a way through and smashed the ball into the roof of the net equalise.
In the 22nd minute, Leah Williamson sent play out right to Baum, who drifted in from the wing and saw her left-footed effort towards the near post saved by Mary Earps.
Georgia Stanway then put Maanum through on goal nicely, but Maria Perez got back to put a crucial block in.
At the other end, Daniela Arques Lazaro tried her luck from distance with a powerful shot curling towards the top right, but Misa Rodriguez got up to tip it over the bar.

Earps made a flying stop to deny Baum just shy of the half-hour mark after our winger received the ball from Maanum, and Kim Little’s corner was then punched clear by Earps only as far as Fox, who cushioned it wide.
Russo subsequently spotted Fox in space on the right and drove a low pass towards her on the edge of the 18-yard box, but her shot was too soft to trouble Earps.
The same went for our next effort, with Fox, Maanum and Foord linking up well before the latter shot straight at Earps first time.
PUSHING AND PROBING
We began the second half in similar fashion, Stanway’s free-kick to Baum fizzed across the face of goal but no-one in the right place to convert.

Poppy Pattinson then tucked the ball around our defence for Goodwin, but Misa rushed out to narrow the angle and saved with the flag going up for offside anyway, before Foord’s cross was going towards the bottom right but Earps got down to push the danger away.

Kadidiatou Diani got on the end of a ball over the top but couldn't create enough of an angle to trouble Misa, and Grace Geyoro fired into the side netting from a narrow angle with London City Lionesses pushing to go ahead themselves.
In response, Maanum played a one-two with Baum before curling wide of the far post, only for Delphine Cascarino to try her luck from long range, smashing the ball onto the crossbar and over.
Renée Slegers made her first two changes in the 73rd minute with Kyra Cooney-Cross and Olivia Smith coming on for Little and Foord.
Smith looked to make an instant impact with a cross in from the left but Earps was quick to get her body in the way before catching the follow-up delivery from Batlle.
Smilla Holmberg came on for Fox, who was forced off with injury in the 83rd minute, before Maanum hit the crossbar at the end of a good counter attack.
We kept Alexia Putellas quiet until the 94th minute, when she fired just over the top left from distance, and Lotte Wubben-Moy came on for Batlle in our last change before the full-time whistle.
WHAT'S NEXT
UEFA Women’s Champions League football returns to Meadow Park in Borehamwood for the visit of Lyon at 8pm on Thursday. Get your tickets!
Then, we’re back at Emirates Stadium against West Ham United in Sunday’s 2.30pm kick-off in the WSL. Join us in N5!

items.titleZh: 比赛报告：阿森纳女足 1-1 伦敦城狮女足
items.summaryZh: 周日下午在酋长球场进行的女子超级联赛中，我们以 1-1 与伦敦城狮女足战平。
bodyZh: 周日下午在酋长球场进行的女子超级联赛中，我们以 1-1 与伦敦城狮女足战平。
继周四客场对阵巴塞罗那破门之后，弗丽达·马努姆开场不久便攻入个人两场比赛中的第二球，帮助球队取得领先，但仅过了一分钟，伊索贝尔·古德温便为客队扳平了比分。
精彩开局
马努姆通过反击推进攻势，并将球分给右路的丽莎·鲍姆，后者内切后找到埃米莉·福克斯，福克斯的射门折射偏出左下角，这是本场比赛我们的第一次机会。
随后鲍姆回传给奥娜·巴特尔，后者在禁区边缘一脚兜射擦着左下角偏出。随后我们取得领先，福克斯带球推进并精准直塞给阿莱西亚·鲁索，鲁索回敲，马努姆推射破门，将比分改写为 1-0。
然而我们的领先优势并未维持多久，古德温找到机会抽射上角破门，将比分扳平。
第 22 分钟，莉亚·威廉姆森将球传到右路的鲍姆，后者从边路内切后的近角左脚射门被玛丽·厄普斯扑出。
随后乔治娅·斯坦韦巧妙地将球直塞给马努姆，但玛丽亚·佩雷斯回防完成了一次关键封堵。
另一端，达妮埃拉·阿尔克斯·拉萨罗尝试了一脚远射，皮球带着向上的弧线飞向右上角，但米莎·罗德里格斯飞身将球托出横梁。
比赛进行到近半场结束时，马努姆将球传给右路的鲍姆，厄普斯飞身扑救化解了险情。随后金·利特尔开出角球，厄普斯将球击出不远，福克斯跟进垫射偏出。
随后鲁索发现右路无人盯防的福克斯，并送出一记低平球传到 18 码禁区边缘，但她的射门力量太轻，未能给厄普斯制造麻烦。
我们接下来的进攻也是如此，福克斯、马努姆和福德配合默契，随后福德直接起脚射门，被厄普斯没收。
持续施压与试探
下半场开始时我们的节奏相似，斯坦韦主罚任意球传给鲍姆，皮球从球门前滑过，但没有队友及时跟进包抄。
随后波比·帕蒂森将球传过我们的防线找到古德温，但米莎快速出击缩小了射门角度并将其扑出，同时边裁示意越位在先。随后福德的传中直奔球门右下角，厄普斯倒地将危险化解。
卡迪蒂亚图·迪亚尼接队友长传后尝试射门，但角度太小未能威胁到米莎。随着伦敦城狮女足试图反超比分，格蕾丝·热约罗在小角度侧网处完成了射门。
对此，马努姆与鲍姆完成撞墙配合后远射偏出远角，随后代尔芬·卡斯卡里诺尝试远射，皮球击中横梁弹飞。
雷妮·斯勒格尔斯在第 73 分钟做出前两次换人调整，基拉·科尼-克罗斯和奥利维亚·史密斯替补登场换下利特尔和福德。
史密斯替补登场后迅速从左路送出传中，但厄普斯反应神速封堵了路线并没收了随后巴特尔的传球。
第 83 分钟，福克斯因伤离场，斯米拉·霍尔姆伯格替补登场。随后在一次精妙的反击末段，马努姆的射门击中横梁。
我们将阿莱西亚·普特利亚斯的进攻限制到第 94 分钟，她才在远距离起脚打门稍稍高出左上角。在终场哨响前，我们用洛特·翁本-莫伊换下了巴特尔。
接下来的赛程
欧洲女子冠军联赛将于周四晚上 8 点重返博勒姆伍德的米多公园球场，我们将迎战里昂。快去买票吧！
随后，我们将在周日下午 2 点 30 分开球的 WSL 比赛中回到酋长球场对阵西汉姆联。我们在 N5 区等您！

items.titleEn: Team news: Two changes against London City
items.summaryEn: Renèe Slegers has made two changes to her starting line-up for today’s Women’s Super League match at home to London City Lionesses.
bodyEn: Renèe Slegers has made two changes to her starting line-up for today’s Women’s Super League match at home to London City Lionesses.
Following Thursday’s 1-1 draw away to Barcelona, Elisa de Almeida and Ona Batlle come into the side to replace Steph Catley and Taylor Hinds.

Emily Fox and Leah Williamson keep their places in defence in front of goalkeeper Misa Rodriguez, and it’s as you were in midfield with Georgia Stanway, Kim Little and Frida Maanum all starting, the latter off the back of her goal at Camp Nou.
Up top, Lisa Baum and Caitlin Foord are either side of Alessia Russo.
Kick-off is at 4.30pm at Emirates Stadium.

items.titleEn: Read Renée's London City Lionesses programme notes
items.summaryEn: Read our head coach's thoughts ahead of the Women's Super League game at home to London City Lionesses
bodyEn: Before every home game, Renée Slegers gives her thoughts around the team and our upcoming game in her manager's notes published in the matchday programme.

Ahead of our Women's Super League match at home to London City Lionesses, the head coach assesses the opposition, reflects on our win over Liverpool last weekend, and talks finding more solutions to win matches.
Good afternoon everyone and welcome to Emirates Stadium, where we’re back in Women’s Super League action.

London City Lionesses were already a good team last year, but they've built quickly and strongly, so they're even better this year. It’s been a great start to the season for them and that position in the league changes the context. We’re all expecting a strong, competitive contest from quality players. They're lethal from fast transitions and counterattacks, so we know that our concentration and defensive discipline can’t drop for a second. Of course, we also see vulnerabilities in their system and the opportunities where we can go on the attack. We'll have to be at our best on Sunday.

Getting the win at Anfield last weekend was very important in terms of building momentum for this game. It was not an easy three points for us. Liverpool are a good side and I really don’t think their position in the table reflects the football they play. They posed us a lot of questions in possession, and we spent more time without the ball than we normally do, while still dominating it. We all agreed after the match that we could have scored more in the first half to get more settled but instead, we defended our lead really solidly until the final whistle. We showed a lot of personality and fight, which is something we want to keep building on. It was a really good win.

There’s no denying that we’ve been disappointed by our results at home this season. Every team that comes to the Emirates has one thing in mind and that's stopping us. So far, all five teams have been successful because we've been held to draws. We need to have better solutions to get the wins over the line but let's see how the game against London City plays out. They have a different identity, there will be different spaces on the pitch for us to exploit. I think today will be a different game.

I see a lot of strength in our group and there’s a lot of positive energy in the camp right now. We’re looking for solutions through difficult times. After the disappointment of the Aston Villa game, we headed to Anfield under a lot of pressure to get the win. The team showed a lot of character to make that happen. We know how to show up in those moments, which is where we take a lot of belief from, so it’s just been a case of working on that consistently.

We’re really looking forward to tonight and unleashing the power of the Emirates. Kick-off is at 4.30, so it will be getting dark under the lights in north London. It will be a special moment with you all this evening. Rudimental are playing before the game, so there will be a good energy in the stadium that we really want to use to our advantage. Then again, it's always our responsibility to deliver for the fans. We want to entertain you with our football and that football needs to lead to the three points. That's what we're going for. COYG!

items.titleZh: 阅读雷妮关于对阵伦敦城雌狮的赛刊寄语
items.summaryZh: 阅读主教练对阵伦敦城雌狮的赛前寄语与思考。
bodyZh: 在每场主场比赛前，雷妮·斯莱格斯都会在比赛日赛刊中发表主教练寄语，分享她对球队以及即将到来的比赛的看法。
在我们在主场迎来对阵伦敦城雌狮的英超联赛之前，主教练对对手进行了评估，回顾了上周末战胜利物浦的比赛，并谈到了寻找更多获胜解决方案的话题。
大家下午好，欢迎来到酋长球场，我们重返英超联赛赛场。
伦敦城雌狮去年已经是一支优秀的球队，但他们建队迅速且实力雄厚，今年变得更强了。对他们来说，这是本赛季一个梦幻般的开局，他们在联赛中的排名改变了比赛的背景。我们都期待着与高水平球员展开一场激烈、有竞争力的较量。他们通过快速转换和反击极具威胁，因此我们知道我们的注意力和防守纪律一秒钟都不能松懈。当然，我们也看到了他们体系中的脆弱性以及我们可以发起进攻的机会。周日我们必须拿出最佳状态。

上周末在安菲尔德取胜对于为这场比赛建立势头非常重要。对我们来说，这三分来之不易。利物浦是一支优秀的球队，我真的认为他们的积分榜排名并未反映出他们的足球水平。他们在控球时给我们出了很多难题，虽然我们仍然占据优势，但无球奔跑的时间比平时要多。赛后我们一致认为，我们在上半场本可以打进更多球以让比赛更稳妥，但取而代之的是，我们坚决地守住了领先优势直到终场哨响。我们展现出了极佳的个性和斗志，这是我们希望继续发扬的。这是一场非常棒的胜利。
不可否认，我们对本赛季的主场战绩感到失望。每一支来到酋长球场的人都只有一个目的，那就是阻止我们。到目前为止，所有五支球队都成功做到了这一点，因为我们都被逼平了。我们需要找到更好的解决方案来锁定胜局，但让我们拭目以待对阵伦敦城的比赛会如何发展。他们有不同的风格，球场上会有不同的空间供我们利用。我认为今天的比赛会是一场不同的较量。
我在我们的团队中看到了强大的力量，目前营地里充满了积极的能量。我们正在艰难时期寻找解决问题的办法。在经历了对阵阿斯顿维拉的失利带来的失望后，我们顶着巨大的赢球压力前往安菲尔德。球队展现出了极强的性格来实现这一目标。我们知道如何在关键时刻挺身而出，这也是我们获得坚定信念的源泉，所以接下来的工作就是持续推进这一点。
我们非常期待今晚的比赛，并释放酋长球场的能量。开球时间是4点30分，所以北伦敦的灯光下将会渐入夜色。今晚与大家在一起将是一个特殊的时刻。Rudimental将在赛前表演，球场内将会充满良好的能量，我们非常希望利用这一点为我们所用。话又说回来，为球迷奉献精彩表现永远是我们的责任。我们希望用我们的足球娱乐大家，而这种足球必须带来三分。这就是我们的目标。COYG！

items.titleEn: Gyokeres scores twice to secure promotion for Sweden
items.summaryEn: Viktor Gyokeres extended his scoring record to help Sweden get promoted in the Nations League
bodyEn: Viktor Gyokeres continued his remarkable UEFA Nations League scoring streak as he netted twice to secure promotion for Sweden against Bosnia & Herzegovina.
Needing a victory to wrap up a place in next season's top division, Sweden made the perfect start as Daniel Svensson netted after five minutes.
Our number 14 then converted two penalties before half-time, meaning he's now scored in eight straight Nations League matches - a record he has extended.
Bosnia fought back with two second-half goals from Armin Gigovic and former Gunner Saed Kolasinac, but it wasn't enough to deny Sweden the win and promotion to League A.
While Sweden are coming up, Martin Odegaard's Norway secured survival in League A with a 3-1 victory over Wales in Oslo.
Martin played 92 minutes as goals from Antonio Nusa, Andreas Schjelderup and Erling Haaland gave Norway victory, ensuring they will finish above Wales due to a better head-to-head record.
Odegaard's nation will need to beat Denmark in the final group game in Copenhagen to finish in the top two and qualify for the quarter-finals after the Danes impressively beat Portugal 4-1 in Lisbon.
Elsewhere, Bruno Guimaraes provided two assists for Brazil, but it wasn't enough to prevent his country from losing 3-2 to Japan in Singapore.
Continuing their tour of Asia from last month, both Bruno and Gabriel started as Japan raced into a 2-0 lead through Takefusa Kubo and Keito Nakamura.
Bruno then laid the ball into the path of Vinicius Jr who smashed in a long-range effort to reduce the deficit before half-time.
Our midfielder then set up Vinicius once again to level the score in the 75th minute, but Japan would have the final say as Tatsuhiro Sakamoto struck in injury time to give the Blue Samurai the win.
Both Bruno and Gabi played the full 90 minutes and will have a chance to bounce back when taking on Singapore on Tuesday, November 17.
Over in South America and Piero Hincapie marked his return to the Ecuador national team with a superb assist in a 2-0 victory over Costa Rica.
Our defender provided an inch-perfect through ball to Jordy Caicedo to open the scoring before Moises Caicedo rounded off the win with a penalty five minutes from time.
Piero and Ecuador will take on Bolivia next week to round off the break.

items.titleZh: 哲凯赖什梅开二度助瑞典升级
items.summaryZh: 哲凯赖什连场破门，帮助瑞典在欧国联中成功升入A级联赛。
bodyZh: 维克托·哲凯赖什延续了他在欧国联中出色的进球势头，他独中两元，帮助瑞典战胜波黑并成功升级。
瑞典需要一场胜利来锁定下赛季顶级联赛的席位，比赛开场仅5分钟，丹尼尔·斯文松就为球队取得完美开局。
随后，我们的14号在半场结束前罚入两记点球，这意味着他已经在连续八场欧国联比赛中取得进球，继续刷新着纪录。
波黑在下半场通过阿尔明·吉戈维奇和前阿森纳球员塞德·科拉西纳茨连扳两球，但这并不足以阻止瑞典取胜并升入A级联赛。
在瑞典升级的同时，厄德高率领的挪威在奥斯陆以3比1战胜威尔士，成功在A级联赛保级。
马丁出场了92分钟，安东尼奥·努萨、安德烈亚斯·舍尔德鲁普和埃尔林·哈兰德的进球为挪威带来胜利，凭借相互战绩优势，他们确保排名高于威尔士。
在丹麦于里斯本以4比1大胜葡萄牙后，厄德高的祖国需要在哥本哈根进行的最后一场小组赛中击败丹麦，才能进入前两名并晋级四分之一决赛。
在其他比赛中，布鲁诺·吉马良斯为巴西贡献两次助攻，但未能阻止球队在新加坡以3比2不敌日本。
延续上个月的亚洲之行，布鲁诺和加布里埃尔均首发出场，当时久保建英和中村敬斗的进球帮助日本取得2比0的领先。
随后，布鲁诺将球传给维尼修斯，后者远射破门，在半场结束前缩小了分差。
我们的中场球员在第75分钟再次助攻维尼修斯扳平比分，但日本队笑到了最后，坂元达裕在补时阶段绝杀，帮助“蓝武士”赢得胜利。
布鲁诺和加比都踢满了90分钟，他们将在11月17日周二对阵新加坡的比赛中迎来反弹的机会。
在南美洲，皮耶罗·因卡皮耶重返厄瓜多尔国家队，并在以2比0战胜哥斯达黎加的比赛中送出了一记精彩的助攻。
我们的后卫送出一记精准的直塞球，助攻约尔迪·凯塞多首开纪录，随后莫伊塞斯·凯塞多在比赛还剩五分钟时罚进点球锁定胜局。
皮耶罗和厄瓜多尔将在下周对阵玻利维亚，为本次国际比赛日画上句号。

items.titleEn: Renée: “I’m expecting a tough challenge against London City”
items.summaryEn: Renée Slegers put some time aside at Camp Nou following Thursday’s 1-1 draw with Barcelona to look ahead to Sunday’s game
bodyEn: Renée Slegers put some time aside at Camp Nou following Thursday’s 1-1 draw with Barcelona in the UEFA Women’s Champions League to look ahead to Sunday’s visit of London City Lionesses at Emirates Stadium.

Asked what she expects from the 4.30pm kick-off in the Women’s Super League, our head coach said: “They're a very good team. Of course, a lot of new players in and a lot of quality. They've started the league really well, so I'm expecting a tough challenge. They've been lethal going forward, fast, so we'll have to be really, really disciplined on the pitch.
“Of course, we look forward to being back at the Emirates and impose ourselves and play the Arsenal way and then build on the performance we had in the Champions League on Thursday night.”
We asked Renée if she’s been surprised by how quickly London City Lionesses have grown in the WSL after being promoted before the start of last season.

“You're always curious how quickly you can build a new team when there's so much happening,” she said. “So yes, quicker than maybe people expected. They look like a team, they look like they know what they're doing on the pitch. So yeah, we're really aware that we're playing against a really good team on Sunday, but like I said, we want to impose ourselves.

“It's the Emirates, we want to play our way. We know we have to be really disciplined, but we want to show what we can do and be our best because the last games at the Emirates haven't become the results that we wanted to. So we're really, really driven and want to do everything to get three points on Sunday.”

Last season’s encounters with London City Lionesses were both victorious for us, as Renée recalled: “The first home game of the season, I remember we went down with a penalty and it was an early penalty for London City. We won that game 4-1, I believe, and they were very aggressive. They [wanted to play] every player on the pitch. We had to find solutions and we did that. So that was a great way to start the season for us at the Emirates.

“The away game was a difficult 2-0 result. We're going to study those games and get the learnings from those games. At the same time, they've changed quite a lot and there's new personnel on their team. It's the here and now and we have changed as well. We look forward to the game.”
Lastly, with plenty of excitement building about our return to Emirates Stadium, we asked Renée just how much of a difference the supporters can make on Sunday.

“They're massive,” she said. “We're always so aware of how they invest to come and be there for us, the energy that they create for us, how it feels in the Emirates. It's of course nothing without the fans at the Emirates. They create the event and the match and the energy. We want to do everything we possibly can to put on a really good performance and go for the three points.”

items.titleZh: 雷妮：预计对阵伦敦城狮将是一场苦战
items.summaryZh: 雷妮展望周日对阵伦敦城狮的比赛，期待球队发挥出最佳水平。
bodyZh: 在周四欧冠对阵巴塞罗那1-1战平后，雷妮·斯莱格斯在诺坎普球场接受了采访，展望了周日伦敦城狮做客酋长球场的比赛。
当被问及对这场下午4点半开球的女足英超联赛有什么期待时，我们的主教练表示：“她们是一支非常优秀的球队。当然，她们引进了许多新球员，具备很高的实力。她们在联赛中开局很好，所以我预计这将是一场艰难的挑战。她们在进攻端极具威胁且速度极快，因此我们在场上必须保持极高的纪律性。”
“当然，我们期待回到酋长球场，打出我们自己的风格，并在周四欧冠晚上的表现基础上再接再厉。”
我们询问雷妮，对于伦敦城狮在升入英超后发展得如此之快是否感到意外。
她说道：“当发生这么多变化时，你总是会对新球队的组建速度感到好奇。所以是的，这比人们预期的可能要快。她们看起来像一支整体，在场上很清楚自己在做什么。所以是的，我们非常清楚周日我们将面对一支非常出色的球队，但就像我说的，我们要掌握主动。”
“这里是酋长球场，我们要踢出自己的风格。我们知道必须保持高度纪律，但我们要展现出我们的能力，发挥出最佳状态，因为最近在酋长球场的比赛结果没有达到我们的预期。所以我们动力十足，愿意竭尽全力在周日全取三分。”
雷妮回忆道，上赛季与伦敦城狮的两次交锋我们都取得了胜利：“我记得本赛季的第一场主场比赛，我们很早就送出了一个点球。我记得我们最终以4-1赢下了那场比赛，当时她们非常有侵略性。她们想要压迫场上的每一名球员。我们必须寻找解决办法，我们也确实做到了。对于我们在酋长球场的赛季开局来说，这是一个极好的开始。”
“客场比赛是一场艰难的2-0。我们将研究这些比赛并从中汲取经验。与此同时，她们发生了很大变化，阵容中有了新面孔。我们要立足当下，我们自己也发生了变化。我们很期待这场比赛。”
最后，随着重返酋长球场的热情高涨，我们询问雷妮球迷们能在周日发挥多大的作用。
她说道：“他们太关键了。我们总是深深感受到他们为支持我们所付出的精力，他们为我们创造的能量，以及在酋长球场的感受。没有球迷在酋长球场，这一切将毫无意义。他们创造了赛事、比赛和能量。我们将竭尽全力奉献精彩表现，全力争取三分。”

items.titleEn: Preview: Arsenal Women v London City Lionesses
items.summaryEn: Women’s Super League football returns to Emirates Stadium with the visit of London City Lionesses at 4.30pm on Sunday.
bodyEn: Women’s Super League football returns to Emirates Stadium with the visit of London City Lionesses at 4.30pm on Sunday.
We'll be looking to get back to winning ways following Thursday's hard-fought 1-1 draw away to Barcelona in the UEFA Women's Champions League.
Get your tickets for a big match in N5, and make sure to take your seat early for a pre-match DJ set from Rudimental!
LIVELY LIONESSES
It’s been an excellent start to the season for a side who were only promoted to the WSL in 2025 and finished seventh in their inaugural campaign.

This season, they beat Manchester United 2-1 at home on the opening weekend before suffering a 2-1 loss at West Ham United and then getting back to winning ways with a 4-1 victory away to Charlton Athletic.

Aside from a 2-1 loss at home to Manchester City, they’ve been unbeaten in all competitions since then, claiming three points over Brighton & Hove Albion, Tottenham Hotspur, Everton, and Birmingham City, while drawing with Liverpool.

The positive run has continued in the Subway Women’s Players Cup, featuring a 2-0 win away to Leicester City, a 1-0 victory at Ipswich Town, a 2-1 win away to West Ham and a 4-2 win at home to Crystal Palace.
It was a busy summer for the club in terms of recruitment as London City signed household names like Mary Earps and Alexia Putellas.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY
Slegers: “Of course, we look forward to being back at the Emirates and impose ourselves and play the Arsenal way and then build on the performance we had in the Champions League on Thursday night.

“It's the Emirates, we want to play our way. We know we have to be really disciplined, but we want to show what we can do and be our best because the last games at the Emirates haven't become the results that we wanted to. So we're really, really driven and want to do everything to get three points on Sunday.” - Read every word of Renée’s pre-London City Lionesses press conference.
Maestre: “Arsenal are one of the biggest teams in the world. I think the next step [for us] is winning these kind of big games against the best teams that are used to being in those top positions.

“They have a lot of potential, they can be a very strong team, whether they play a more possession based style of playing, or they can be in that kind of low to block to punish on the counter-attack. Hopefully we can implement our identity, and if we have to choose one side to play against them, hopefully we can keep the ball in their half and try to be dominant."
TEAM NEWS
We have no fresh injury concerns from Thursday's trip to the Camp Nou, where we drew 1-1 with Barcelona.
Ona Batlle returned to action against her former club, and Frida Maanum, in her first start since returning from injury, marked her return to the XI with the opening goal of the night.
While there are no new injuries, we will still be without Stina Blackstenius, Chloe Kelly, Selina Cerci, Mariona Caldentey, Michelle Agyemang and Katie Reid.
FACTS AND STATS
We have won all seven of our meetings with London City Lionesses across all competitions by an aggregate score of 22-1.
London City Lionesses’ first ever game in the WSL ended in a 4-1 away defeat to us in September last year, before they lost the reverse fixture 2-0 in March.

This will be Renée’s 50th WSL game in charge of us, with only Chelsea (3) losing fewer matches among ever-present sides in the competition since her first game in charge of the club (6). In that time, only Manchester City (131) have netted more goals in total than us (121).

Georgia Stanway has completed 239 successful passes that have ended in the final third in the WSL this season, 59 more than any other player, while she leads her teammates for most passes played into the opposition’s penalty area (41).
MATCH OFFICIALS
Melissa Burgin has been appointed to take charge of Sunday’s match, assisted by Jon Ashworth-Sears and Phoebe Horner with Kirsty Dowle the Fourth Official.
Burgin has seen over three WSL matches this season so far, handing out four yellow cards and no reds.
The last Arsenal game she was involved in was our 3-0 win away to Aston Villa in May last season.

HOW TO WATCH
Sunday’s game will be shown live on Sky Sports Main Event in the UK. Elsewhere in the world, take a look through our how to watch article for the full list of broadcasters.

充满活力的雌狮
对于一支在2025年才升入英超女足联赛并在处子赛季获得第七名的球队来说，本赛季的开局非常出色。
本赛季，他们在首轮主场2-1击败曼联，随后2-1不敌西汉姆联，接着在客场4-1大胜查尔顿重回胜轨。
除了主场2-1输给曼城之外，此后他们在各项赛事中保持不败，先后击败了布莱顿、托特纳姆热刺、埃弗顿和伯明翰城，并与利物浦战平。
这一良好的势头在女足联赛杯中延续，包括客场2-0战胜莱斯特城、客场1-0击败伊普斯维奇、客场2-1战胜西汉姆以及主场4-2击败水晶宫。
俱乐部在今夏的引援市场上动作频繁，伦敦城签下了玛丽·厄普斯和阿莱克西亚·普特利亚斯等知名球星。
主教练言论
斯勒格斯：“当然，我们期待重返酋长球场，打出我们自己的风格，踢出阿森纳的方式，并在周四晚上的欧冠表现基础上继续前进。”
“这是酋长球场，我们想要踢出自己的风格。我们知道必须高度纪律严明，但我们想展现自己的能力，做到最好，因为最近在酋长球场的比赛结果没有达到我们想要的。所以我们非常有动力，渴望在周日尽一切努力全取三分。” - 阅读雷妮赛前新闻发布会的全部内容。
马埃斯特：“阿森纳是世界上的大俱乐部之一。我认为我们的下一步就是赢得这种与习惯处于顶尖位置的最强球队较量的大场面比赛。”
“他们潜力巨大，无论采取控球为主的踢法，还是通过低位防守伺机反击，都能成为一支非常强大的球队。希望我们能贯彻自己的风格，如果在比赛中必须选择一种战术，希望我们能将球控制在对方半场并占据主导地位。”
球队新闻
我们在周四客场战平巴塞罗那后没有新增的伤病困扰。
奥娜·巴特莱在对阵老东家的比赛中复出，而伤愈复出的弗丽达·马努姆首次重返首发阵容便攻入了当晚的首开纪录进球。
虽然没有新增伤员，但我们依然缺少斯蒂娜·布莱克斯特纽斯、克洛伊·凯利、塞利娜·切尔奇、玛丽奥娜·卡尔登泰、米歇尔·阿杰芒和凯蒂·里德。
数据统计
我们在各项赛事中对阵伦敦城雌狮的七场比赛全部取胜，总比分为22-1。
伦敦城雌狮在英超女足联赛历史上的首场比赛是在去年9月客场1-4输给我们，随后在3月份的客场交锋中0-2落败。
这将是雷妮带队进行的第50场英超女足联赛，自从她上任以来，在该联赛所有全勤球队中，只有切尔西（3场）输掉的比赛比我们更少（6场）。在此期间，只有曼城（131球）的总进球数多于我们（121球）。
乔治娅·斯坦韦本赛季在英超女足联赛中完成了239次进攻三区的成功传球，比其他任何球员多出59次，同时她也是队友中向对方禁区传球次数最多的球员（41次）。
裁判安排
梅丽莎·伯金将执法周日的比赛，助理裁判为乔恩·阿什沃思-塞尔斯和菲比·霍纳，第四官员为基尔斯蒂·多夫尔。
伯金本赛季至今已执法了三场以上的英超女足联赛，出示了四张黄牌，没有红牌。
她参与执法的上一场阿森纳比赛是我们上赛季5月客场3-0战胜阿斯顿维拉的比赛。

如何观赛

items.summaryEn: Alessia Russo has been nominated for the BBC Women’s Footballer of the Year 2026 award
bodyEn: Alessia Russo has been nominated for the prestigious BBC Women’s Footballer of the Year 2026 award - and your votes can help her land the prize!

Alessia has been included on a five-player shortlist thanks to her goalscoring exploits for club and country during the 2025/26 campaign, which she hopes can land her the annual BBC World Service award, which is now in its 12th year recognising the world's leading female footballers

Players worldwide were nominated by a large panel of experts, including coaches, players, administrators and non-BBC journalists; however, the award is distinctive as it gives fans around the world the final say through their votes.
Alessia is up against Temwa Chawinga, Ewa Pajor, Alexia Putellas and Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw.
You can cast yours now, with voting closing at 9am on Wednesday, November 19, with the winner announced at the BBC Sports Personality of the Year awards on December 13.
Three Gunners players have previously been named BBC Women’s Footballer of the Year: Kim Little in 2016, Vivianne Miedema in 2021 and Beth Mead in 2022, while Alessia came second last year.

The 2025/26 season was her best ever in front of goal, scoring 24 goals in 40 matches in all competitions for us, which included an unforgettable hat-trick in March’s north London derby, which saw us beat Tottenham Hotspur 5-2 at Emirates Stadium.

Her efforts in Europe last term earned her a place in the Women’s Champions League Team of the Season, having scored nine goals in 12 matches as we reached the semi-finals. She was also part of the team that won the inaugural FIFA Women’s Champions Cup.

Individual accolades came in the form of Player of the Season awards for club and country, inclusions in the PFA WSL Team of the Season and FIFPRO World 11, and the Golden Player awarded by Tuttosport.

For England, she scored in a 1-0 win over Iceland in Women’s World Cup qualifying, entering the Lionesses' top 10 all-time goal-scorers, while her hat-trick against Benfica last month saw her become the highest-scoring English player in Women's Champions League history.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳前锋阿莱西亚·鲁索入围2026年BBC年度最佳女足运动员候选名单。
bodyZh: 阿莱西亚·鲁索入围了2026年BBC年度最佳女足运动员大奖的候选名单，您的投票可以帮助她赢得这一奖项！
凭借在2025/26赛季俱乐部和国家队比赛中的出色进球表现，阿莱西亚进入了五人候选名单。她有望赢得这项由BBC世界服务部设立、旨在表彰全球顶尖女足运动员且已进入第12个年头的年度奖项。
来自世界各地的球员由包括教练、球员、管理者和非BBC记者在内的大型专家评审团提名；然而，该奖项的独特之处在于它让全球球迷通过投票做出最后决定。
阿莱西亚将与特姆瓦·查温加、埃瓦·帕霍尔、阿莱克西亚·普特利亚斯以及卡迪莎·“邦尼”·肖展开竞争。
您现在就可以投票，投票将于11月19日星期三上午9点截止，获奖者将于12月13日的BBC年度体坛风云人物颁奖典礼上公布。
此前已有三名阿森纳球员荣膺BBC年度最佳女足运动员：金·利特尔（2016年）、薇薇安·米德马（2021年）和贝丝·米德（2022年），而阿莱西亚在去年获得了第二名。
2025/26赛季是她进球效率最高的一个赛季，她在各项赛事为我们出场40次打入24球，其中包括三月份在酋长球场进行的北伦敦德比中上演难忘的帽子戏法，帮助我们以5-2击败托特纳姆热刺。
她在上赛季欧洲赛场的表现让她入选了女足欧冠赛季最佳阵容，在打入9球并帮助球队杀入半决赛的12场比赛中表现亮眼。她也是赢得首届国际足联女足冠军杯的球队成员之一。
个人荣誉方面，她获得了俱乐部和国家队的赛季最佳球员奖，入选了PFA女足英超赛季最佳阵容和国际职业足球运动员联合会（FIFPRO）世界最佳阵容，并荣获了《都灵体育报》颁发的欧洲金球员奖。
在英格兰队方面，她在女足世界杯预选赛以1-0战胜冰岛的比赛中取得进球，跻身雌狮队历史射手榜前十；而上个月对阵本菲卡时上演的帽子戏法，则让她成为了女足欧冠历史上进球最多的英格兰球员。

bodyEn: It would have been very easy for Oliver Glasner to lose patience with Liam Delap. The forward is still only 23, yet the days when he was rattling in 12 in a Premier League season for Ipswich have come to seem a very long time ago (and his six games for Manchester City even longer). A season at Chelsea had left him bereft of confidence, an odd mix of diffidence and overaggression, devoid of composure in the box, arms flailing like a broken windmill. But the old gifts have not left him. Both goals on Saturday were the result of great muscular surges and if the first finish seemed essentially about hitting the ball as hard as possible on target, the second was a precise – and still powerful – finish in off the far post. After games such as this it’s possible to imagine him as England’s long-term replacement for Harry Kane. Jonathan Wilson
Match report: Nottingham Forest 3-1 Manchester City

Amid the chaotic blur of proceedings at Old Trafford, there was one outstanding performance. Alysson had only one goal to his name in his Premier League career at Aston Villa, but he scored one and helped set up another two in the first 48 minutes against Manchester United. The 20-year-old winger, who has represented Brazil only at under-16 level, was signed from Grêmio for an initial £8.7m last January. His only goal in 18 previous appearances was against Nottingham Forest in September – it took less than a minute to open the scoring at United and less than four for his saved shot to rebound out to Nicolas Jackson for Villa’s second. United’s right-back, Diogo Dalot, was too slow to close Alysson down for his opener and did not have any complaints when his trip on the Brazilian conceded a penalty at the start of the second half. Dalot, often the face of United’s struggles, was booed off when substituted in the second half – Alysson was applauded off by the away end. Billy Munday
Match report: Manchester United 4-4 Aston Villa

Diego Gómez is the latest example of a slow-burning Brighton player given the chance and space to bed in before then flourishing. His current status is as an overnight sensation, though a taste for the spectacular and an eye for goal have been obvious since two goals against Leeds in November 2025. Gómez had signed from Inter Miami that January. The inside-right position from which he drilled his left-foot sidewinder to open the scoring against Brentford brings the best from his shooting prowess with both feet. His October halfway line strike against Crystal Palace came with his right foot. As with a number of Brighton’s purchases, Gómez can play in other positions, variously defensive midfielder, attacking midfielder, even on the wing. Within Fabian Hürzeler’s stringent tactical setup, he is asked to work hard for the ball. Such high pressing created the opportunity Charalampos Kostoulas should have done better with in the moments after the opening goal. John Brewin
Match report: Brighton 2-0 Brentford

There is nothing wrong with Arsenal’s habit of winning games by a single goal: Mikel Arteta’s side did it 15 times on their way to the title last season and the latest against Hull was their fourth this season. Yet despite being six points clear of Manchester City heading into the international break, Arteta will have some concerns about the lack of goals so far. With only 15 from their first 10 matches, Arsenal are on course to break Manchester United’s record of 67 for the fewest by a team being crowned champions in 1993 – the Premier League’s first season. They have also been struggling to score in the first half of games, having gone six matches in all competitions without doing so last month, and Arteta has called on his players to be more ruthless. “Sometimes we try to score the perfect goal against low blocks, but we need to be much more chaotic than that. If we open the scoring much earlier also, it changes the game,” he said. Ed Aarons
Match report: Arsenal 1-0 Hull

All hail Brian Brobbey. It is fascinating that a player sometimes derided for his supposed lack of technical quality while at Ajax has developed into one of the Premier League’s most potent and difficult-to-play centre-forwards in little more than a year in England. His new contract, announced last Wednesday, is richly deserved. There is, as Régis Le Bris acknowledged after the win over Chelsea in which he bullied the visitors, no one quite like him. “Against a team that wants to press like that it’s so important to have a target man,” said the Sunderland manager, and Brobbey was that and then some. Much has been made of how Chelsea miss João Pedro but the Mackems are a different team with their flying Dutchman. Andy Brassell
Match report: Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea

It was a tale of two benches at Elland Road. The big question hanging over Leeds is whether they have the support for Dominic Calvert-Lewin to make a concerted push for Europe this season; a question that went some way to being answered when the substitutes Harry Wilson and Noah Okafor combined for the latter to score the winner against Tottenham. In contrast, Roberto De Zerbi’s attacking options let him down in a game that felt there for the taking. Dominic Solanke struggled after replacing Mathys Tel, Omar Marmoush looked limited in the central striker role and their brightest performer was the 18-year-old Lucá Williams-Barnett, who, you would suspect, is now not far from a deserved start. Having won three straight games before their defeat in West Yorkshire, Spurs suddenly go into the international break with more questions than answers over their attacking credentials once again. Aaron Bower

Match report: Leeds 1-0 Tottenham

Andoni Iraola had one wish as he signed off for the international window with the 3-1 win at Crystal Palace – that he does not lose any players to injury before Liverpool are back in action against Manchester United at Anfield on Sunday week. The manager is scarred by the previous round of international fixtures: Dominik Szoboszlai, Cody Gakpo and Alexander Isak all picked up problems. The trio were missed as Liverpool lost to Manchester City in the first game back. Szoboszlai’s injury was the most concerning: he was only able to return as a substitute in the defeat against Arsenal on 1 November and Iraola said after the win at Palace that the Hungary midfielder was not 100%, that a knee problem required management. “Let’s see if Dom can play with the national team or not,” Iraola said. “I know what I want! But I have to understand the national teams. Also I’m sure Dom will want to go. I’m not sure if it’s going to be fine.” David Hytner
Match report: Crystal Palace 1-3 Liverpool

Bournemouth are really getting to grips with the Thursday-Sunday grind in their first season in Europe. Marco Rose has been working hard to ensure his team are in the right shape to start Premier League games quickly after a Europa League assignment three days earlier. After Thursday’s trip to face Sparta Prague, Bournemouth were quick out of the traps at Ipswich on Sunday, taking the lead through Evanilson after five minutes. “Last week [against Leeds] I said we start slow and this week we start quite quick and score an early goal – I am a magician,” said the head coach, after their eighth consecutive win in all competitions. That equalled a club record set under Eddie Howe in League One. Evanilson is himself on a streak – he’s scored in five in a row in the league – and only Nicolas Jackson has scored as many in the top flight since the last international break. The Brazilian did not need Christian Walton’s helping hand with this goal. BM
Match report: Ipswich 1-2 Bournemouth

Newcastle delivered one of their more convincing performances of the season at Fulham, but one area remains a headache for Matthias Jaissle. Efforts to replace Alexander Isak in attack have not been good enough. Nick Woltemade was loaned to Juventus after an inconsistent debut season in England and there was not much encouragement to take from how Yoane Wissa and William Osula played at Craven Cottage. Wissa, who has struggled since his £55m move from Brentford last summer, has four goals in 41 appearances and did not put himself about enough before being taken off after 61 minutes, while Osula did not manage a touch in Fulham’s area and lost possession before Rodrigo Muniz’s late equaliser for the hosts. Jaissle needs more from his forwards on and off the ball. Otherwise Newcastle are going to need to find different players to lead their attack. Jacob Steinberg
Match report: Fulham 1-1 Newcastle

The laws on hair-pulling were changed for this season after the red cards that were issued to Michael Keane, Lisandro Martínez and Dan Ballard in 2025-26. They are undoubtedly an improvement but, as James Tarkowski’s pull on Caleb Yirenkyi’s hair demonstrated in Everton’s comeback against Coventry, grey areas remain. Frank Lampard and David Moyes agreed the Everton captain should not have been sent off as there was no excessive force involved. But was it “a clear action without excessive force” that should have resulted in a yellow card for unsporting behaviour and a penalty to Coventry? Or “negligible, accidental or inadvertent contact” that is not usually considered an offence? Moyes offered up one solution – scrap the law altogether. “I think it is still ridiculous that is even categorised in the rules of the game,” the Everton manager said. “I can’t understand why they don’t fix this completely because I don’t see it as a good rule at all.” Andy Hunter
Match report: Everton 3-1 Coventry

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳一球小胜赫尔城领跑英超，但进球效率引发阿尔特塔关注。
bodyZh: 奥利弗·格拉斯纳对利亚姆·德拉普失去耐心原本是非常容易的事情。这位前锋年仅23岁，但他此前在伊普斯维奇单赛季攻入12球的辉煌时期似乎已经过去很久（他在曼城的六场比赛则更加遥远）。在切尔西的一个赛季让他丧失了信心，展现出一种既自信不足又过度激进的矛盾混合体，在禁区内毫无冷静可言，双臂挥舞得像个破风车。但昔日的天赋并未抛弃他。周六的两粒进球都是强力冲击的结果，如果说第一脚射门本质上是以最大力量将球打向目标，那么第二记则是精确且极具力量的远角破门。经历这样的比赛后，人们完全可以想象他成为英格兰队哈里·凯恩的长期替代者。乔纳森·威尔逊
比赛报告：诺丁汉森林 3-1 曼城

在老特拉福德混乱的比赛中，有一场表现格外耀眼。阿利森在阿斯顿维拉的英超生涯中此前只有过一个进球，但在对阵曼联的前48分钟里，他不仅打进一球还助攻两次。这位20岁的边锋此前仅代表巴西U16国家队出场，去年1月以870万英镑的初始转会费从格雷米奥加盟。他在过去的18次出场中唯一的进球是在9月对阵诺丁汉森林时打进的——此役开场不到一分钟他就攻破了曼联球门，不到四分钟他的射门被扑出后又助攻尼古拉斯·杰克逊打进维拉的第二球。曼联右后卫迪奥戈·达洛特在丢球时回防太慢，而在下半场初段因放倒这名巴西球员送出点球时也无话可说。达洛特常常是曼联困境的缩影，他在下半场被换下时遭到嘘声，而阿利森则在客队球迷的掌声中离场。比利·芒迪
比赛报告：曼联 4-4 阿斯顿维拉

迭戈·戈麦斯是布赖顿又一个低调起步、在获得时间和空间适应后最终大放异彩的例子。他目前的形象仿佛是一夜成名，但自2025年11月对阵利兹联独中两元以来，他对精彩进球的追求和门前感觉就显而易见。戈麦斯是当年1月从迈阿密国际加盟的。他在右肋部用左脚内侧兜射攻破布伦特福德球门的位置，最能展现他双脚出众的射门能力。去年10月对阵水晶宫时他在中圈附近的吊射则是用右脚完成的。就像布赖顿的许多引援一样，戈麦斯能够胜任多个位置，包括防守型中场、进攻型中场甚至边锋。在法比安·许策尔严苛的战术体系中，他被要求积极拼抢球权。正是这种高位逼抢为查拉兰波斯·科斯图拉斯在首开纪录后创造了本应把握得更好的机会。约翰·布鲁因
比赛报告：布赖顿 2-0 布伦特福德

阿森纳习惯于以一球优势赢得比赛并没有错：米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在上赛季夺冠历程中有15次做到这一点，而最近对阵赫尔城的胜利是他们本赛季的第四场。然而，尽管在进入国际比赛日时领先曼城6分，阿尔特塔对目前的进球乏力仍有一些担忧。在前10场比赛中仅打入15球的阿森纳，正朝着打破曼联在1993年（英超首个赛季）创下的夺冠球队最少进球纪录（67球）的方向发展。他们在比赛上半场也一直难以取得进球，上个月曾在各项赛事中连续六场比赛在上半场颗粒无收，阿尔特塔已呼吁球员们在门前更加冷酷无情。“有时我们试图在密集防守面前打进完美的进球，但我们需要比那更加混乱。如果我们能更早打破僵局，比赛形势也会随之改变，”他说。埃德·阿伦斯
比赛报告：阿森纳 1-0 赫尔城

向布莱恩·布罗贝伊致敬。令人着迷的是，这位在效力阿贾克斯时曾因所谓的缺乏技术能力而饱受嘲讽的球员，在登陆英格兰一年多后，已经成长为英超最具威力和最难以防守的中锋之一。他于上周三宣布续约，这是他应得的。正如雷吉斯·勒布里斯在击败切尔西并压制住对手后所承认的那样，没有人能像他一样。“面对一支想要这样进行高位逼抢的球队，拥有一名柱式中锋是如此重要，”这位桑德兰主帅说道，而布罗贝伊不仅做到了这一点，还做得更多。人们对切尔西缺少若昂·佩德罗议论纷纷，但缺少了这位荷兰飞翼的桑德兰将是另一支球队。安迪·布拉塞尔
比赛报告：桑德兰 1-0 切尔西

这是埃兰路球场两队替补席形成鲜明对比的故事。悬在利兹头上最大的问题是，他们是否有足够的阵容厚度支持多米尼克·卡尔弗特-勒温在本赛季向欧战发起全力冲击；当替补登场的哈里·威尔逊和诺亚·奥卡福连线并由后者攻入绝杀热刺的进球时，这个问题在一定程度上得到了解答。相比之下，罗伯托·德泽尔比的进攻选择在比赛中让人失望。多米尼克·索兰克在替换马蒂斯·特尔后举步维艰，奥马尔·马尔穆什在中锋位置上显得办法不多，而他们表现最亮眼的球员是18岁的卢卡·威廉姆斯-巴内特，你可能会觉得他现在距离获得首发机会已经不远了。在西约克郡失利之前取得三连胜的热刺，在进入国际比赛日之际，其进攻资质再次引发了更多疑问而非答案。阿伦·鲍尔

安东尼·伊劳拉带着在水晶宫客场3-1取胜的战绩进入国际比赛日，他只有一个愿望——希望在下周日利物浦前往安菲尔德对阵曼联之前，不要有任何球员在国家队比赛中受伤。这位主帅对上一轮国际比赛日心有余悸：多米尼克·索博斯洛伊、科迪·加克波和亚历山大·伊萨克都遇到了伤病问题。利物浦在回归后的首场比赛中输给曼城时，非常想念这三人。索博斯洛伊的伤情最令人担忧：直到11月1日输给阿森纳的比赛中他才作为替补复出，伊劳拉在客胜水晶宫后表示这位匈牙利中场并未完全恢复100%，膝盖问题需要管理。“让我们看看多姆是否能为国家队出场吧，”伊劳拉说。“我知道我想要什么！但我必须理解国家队。而且我也确信多姆会想要去。我不确定这一切是否会顺利。”大卫·海特纳
比赛报告：水晶宫 1-3 利物浦

伯恩茅斯在参加欧战的首个赛季中，正逐渐适应周四与周日连轴转的赛程。马可·罗斯一直在努力确保球队在三天前参加完欧联杯任务后，能够以正确的体能状态迅速进入英超比赛的节奏。在周四前往客场面对布拉格斯巴达后，伯恩茅斯周日在伊普斯维奇迅速进入状态，并在第5分钟由埃凡尼尔松取得领先。“上周（对阵利兹时）我说我们开局慢，而这周我们开局相当快并打进了一个早早的进球——我简直是个魔术师，”这位主教练在球队取得各项赛事八连胜后说道。这追平了埃迪·豪在英甲时期创下的俱乐部纪录。埃凡尼尔松本人也处于连场进球的势头中——他在联赛中已经连续五场破门，自上一个国际比赛日以来，只有尼古拉斯·杰克逊在顶级联赛中的进球数能与他媲美。这位巴西人的进球并没有借助克里斯蒂安·沃尔顿的帮助。BM
比赛报告：伊普斯维奇 1-2 伯恩茅斯

纽卡斯尔联队在富勒姆踢出了本赛季最具说服力的表现之一，但有一个区域仍然让马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯尔头疼。寻找亚历山大·伊萨克替代者的努力还远远不够。尼克·沃尔特马德在经历了英格兰的首个起伏不定的赛季后被租借至尤文图斯，而约安·维萨和威廉·奥苏拉在克拉文农场的表现也并没有带来多少鼓舞。维萨自从去年夏天以5500万英镑从布伦特福德转会以来一直举步维艰，在41次出场中仅攻入4球，在第61分钟被换下之前也没有发挥足够的作用，而奥苏拉在富勒姆禁区内甚至没有完成一次触球，并在主队由罗德里戈·穆尼斯打入绝平球之前丢掉了球权。贾伊斯尔需要他的前锋在进攻和防守时都发挥更大作用。否则，纽卡斯尔将不得不寻找其他球员来引领他们的进攻。雅各布·斯坦伯格
比赛报告：富勒姆 1-1 纽卡斯尔联

拉扯头发的规则在本赛季进行了更改，此前迈克尔·基恩、利桑德罗·马丁内斯和丹·巴拉德在2025-26赛季都曾因此吃到红牌。这些改变无疑是一种进步，但正如詹姆斯·塔科夫斯基在埃尔文·基伦基的头发上拉扯所表明的那样，埃尔文对阵考文垂的逆转比赛中灰色地带依然存在。弗兰克·兰帕德和大卫·莫耶斯一致认为这位埃尔文队长不应该被罚下，因为其中并不包含过度用力。但这究竟是应该因非体育行为吃到黄牌并判给考文垂点球的“没有过度力气的清晰动作”？还是通常不被视为犯规的“微不足道、意外或无意的接触”？莫耶斯给出了一个解决方案——彻底废除这条规则。“我认为将其列入比赛规则依然荒谬，”这位埃尔文主帅说道，“我无法理解他们为什么不彻底解决这个问题，因为我根本不认为这是一条好规则。”安东尼·亨特

bodyEn: As most Arsenal supporters would testify, patience is a virtue. They needed plenty during the 22-year wait to be crowned Premier League champions and Mikel Arteta’s side certainly had to retain their composure as they tried to break down a dogged Hull side. They had not beaten Arsenal in 14 attempts since winning on their first visit to this ground in 2008. But with 20 minutes to play, there was still every chance that Sergej Jakirovic’s team could have pulled off one of the shocks of the season.

Arsenal had already been denied a penalty just before half-time for a shirt pull on Kai Havertz in the box a week after escaping the same crime against Liverpool at Anfield, in a moment of controversy that could have been the major talking point from this match. Martin Ødegaard had other ideas and the Arsenal captain’s fifth goal of the season was enough to ensure they will go into the international break with a healthy lead over Manchester City. Enzo Maresca’s side are up next here in the league after the international break, with Arsenal having matched their record tally of 27 points from their opening 10 games. The signs look ominous for the rest, even if they were made to work for the points throughout by their opponents.

“To the international break after winning is one of the best things for a coach,” said Arteta. “I need to praise the players and all the staff for the work that they are doing because it’s been very, very demanding. We have a very short time to recover from games but despite that the mentality and the quality of the team has shown: it’s incredible.”

Jakirovic had promised beforehand that his side would go on the front foot. “If you are passive, they will destroy you,” said the Bosnian. But while his bold 5-3-2 formation caused Arsenal’s much-vaunted defence some issues, Hull remain without a league victory since the end of August. “It’s a big experience for us,” was Jakirovic’s post-match assessment. “We can take some big lessons from this but we have shown we can compete at this level.”

Hull made the brighter start as John Egan headed wide from a corner. After losing to Brighton before the last international break, Arteta was taking no chances and reverted to the side that won at Liverpool last weekend. There was no William Saliba on the bench, with the France defender set to play for the under-21s on Sunday instead as he continues his comeback from a back injury.

Yet aside from a set piece that resulted in Gabriel Magalhães just failing to connect with Ezri Konsa’s flick-on, the visitors’ low block frustrated Arsenal and they continued to cause problems on the break. Elliot Stroud forced David Raya into a save after Riccardo Calafiori surrendered possession cheaply.

Havertz’s failure to take a shot after being played in by a slide-rule pass from Ødegaard drew groans of frustration. A toiling Arsenal thought all their prayers had been answered just before half-time when the referee, Farai Hallam, was sent to the big screen by the VAR. Nobel Mendy was clearly pulling Havertz’s shirt inside the area yet the German was offside so the penalty was not awarded, even though it probably should have been according to the rules. They state that Havertz must be “attempting to play the ball, or challenging an opponent for the ball” to be penalised and because Mendy’s offence came first, that should have taken precedence, as it did when Newcastle’s Fabian Schär was awarded a penalty against Bournemouth in February 2024.

Pro Ref has yet to make a statement on the incident and Arteta admitted he had been left confused by the whole episode. “I don’t know what the interpretation is, I’m sure they will make that clear to understand,” he said.

The Arsenal manager’s annoyance levels continued to rise when Havertz could only head straight at Konstantinos Tzolakis on the stroke of half-time. Hull came out for the second half with a similar attitude and Jakirovic picked up a yellow card for protesting against another decision that went against his team. Declan Rice was withdrawn early, although Arteta insisted he was fine afterwards. Noni Madueke found space after a flowing Arsenal move but again his effort was straight down the throat of Tzolakis.

The feeling of desperation was growing. But Ødegaard has made a habit of coming to Arsenal’s rescue this season and the captain was quickest to react when Tzolakis spilled Madueke’s shot to finally break Hull’s brave resistance.

items.titleZh: 厄德高制胜球助阿森纳扩大英超领头羊优势
items.summaryZh: 厄德高打入全场唯一进球，帮助阿森纳击败顽强的对手，在积分榜上保持领先。
bodyZh: 正如大多数阿森纳支持者所证明的那样，耐心是一种美德。在长达22年的英超冠军等待期里，他们需要极大的耐心，而米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在试图击溃顽强的赫尔城时，显然也必须保持冷静。自2008年首次客场取胜以来，赫尔城在随后的14次交锋中均未能击败阿森纳。但在比赛还剩20分钟时，塞尔热·雅基罗维奇的球队依然完全有可能制造本赛季最大冷门之一。

在上周做客安菲尔德对阵利物浦逃过类似判罚的一周后，阿森纳在半场结束前再次因禁区内拉扯哈弗茨球衣而未能获得点球，这一争议时刻本可能成为本场比赛的主要谈资。但马丁·厄德高有不同的想法，这位阿森纳队长打入了本赛季的第五个进球，足以确保他们带着对曼城的健康领先优势进入国际比赛日。接下来在联赛中，阿尔特塔的球队将在国际比赛日后对阵恩佐·马雷斯卡的球队，而阿森纳前10场比赛已追平了27分的纪录积分。对于其他对手而言，形势显得不太妙，尽管他们整场比赛都不得不通过苦战来争取积分。
“带着胜利进入国际比赛日对教练来说是最好的事情之一，”阿尔特塔说道，“我必须赞扬球员和所有工作人员所做的工作，因为这非常、非常严苛。我们在比赛后只有很短的时间来恢复，但尽管如此，球队的心态和质量依然展现出来了：这太不可思议了。”
雅基罗维奇此前曾承诺他的球队会采取主动进攻。“如果你被动，他们就会摧毁你，”这位波黑人说道。虽然他大胆的5-3-2阵型给阿森纳备受赞誉的防线制造了一些麻烦，但赫尔城自8月底以来依然一场联赛未胜。“对我们来说这是一次伟大的经历，”雅基罗维奇在赛后评价道，“我们可以从中吸取一些重大的教训，但我们已经证明了自己有能力在这个水平上竞争。”
赫尔城开局表现更好，约翰·埃根接角球头球偏出。在上次国际比赛日之前输给布莱顿后，阿尔特塔不敢冒险，恢复了上周末客胜利物浦时的首发阵容。威廉·萨利巴没有进入替补席，这位法国后卫将在周日代表U21梯队出场，以继续他的背部伤势康复进程。

然而，除了加布里埃尔·马加良斯险些接应到埃兹里·孔萨的头球摆渡的一次定位球外，客队的低位防守让阿森纳感到受挫，他们在反击中继续制造麻烦。里卡多·卡拉菲奥里漫不经心地丢失球权后，埃利奥特·斯特鲁德迫使大卫·拉亚做出了一次扑救。

厄德高送出精妙直塞后，哈弗茨未能完成射门，这引来了一阵沮丧的叹息声。在上半场结束前，苦战的阿森纳曾以为他们的所有祈祷都得到了回应，当时主裁判法赖·哈勒姆被VAR叫到场边看回放。诺贝尔·门迪显然在禁区内拉扯了哈弗茨的球衣，但由于这名德国球员越位在先，因此没有判罚点球，尽管根据规则本可能应该判罚。规则规定哈弗茨必须“试图去踢球，或与对手争夺球权”才会受到惩罚，由于门迪的犯规发生在先，因此理应优先处理，就像2024年2月纽卡斯尔联队的法比安·舍尔对阵伯恩茅斯时获得点球的情况一样。
职业裁判公司（Pro Ref）尚未对该事件发表声明，阿尔特塔承认他对整个事件感到困惑。“我不知道具体的解释是什么，我确信他们会把这一点解释清楚，”他说。
当哈弗茨在上半场结束前只能将球顶向康斯坦丁诺斯·佐拉基斯怀中时，阿森纳主帅的愤怒情绪继续上升。赫尔城下半场带着相似的态度出场，雅基罗维奇因抗议另一个对他们不利的判罚而吃到黄牌。德克兰·赖斯被提前换下，不过阿尔特塔坚称他赛后一切正常。非尼·马杜埃凯在阿森纳流畅的配合中找到了空间，但他的射门再次直奔佐拉基斯怀里。
绝望感在不断滋长。但厄德高本赛季已经习惯了拯救阿森纳，当佐拉基斯扑脱了马杜埃凯的射门时，这位队长反应最快，终于打破了赫尔城勇敢的抵抗。

items.titleEn: Premier League news: Arteta insists Rice isn’t playing too many games
items.summaryEn: The Arsenal manager says ‘we’re really looking after’ midfielder, while Andoni Iraola backs keeper Alisson Continue reading...
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has defended Arsenal’s treatment of Declan Rice and insisted they “are looking after him more than any other season”.

Rice withdrew from the England squad in September but the midfielder was one of five Arsenal players called up by Thomas Tuchel on Friday, despite signs of fatigue during the second half of Wednesday’s Champions League win at Slavia Prague. The 27-year-old, who was affected by a long-term back and hamstring problems during the World Cup, was also rested for Arsenal’s shootout defeat at Fleetwood in the Carabao Cup, having featured in every Premier League and Champions League game.
“Concerns?” Arteta said. “Which is the only player in this squad that for two games in the Carabao Cup has been left out of the squad? At home with two days off. That’s my concern.

“It’s not true [that Rice has been overplayed]. We are really looking after him more than any other season. The way he’s training and all the love. That’s it. Here are the demands of this football club and you have a player like him. Not only him because there are many others that have even less time. That’s it. That has to be the mindset. If you start to put other things in your brain, damage. Erase them, get them in the bin and just focus on what you have to do.”

Ben White’s return to the England squad for the first time since before the World Cup means the Arsenal contingent makes up a fifth of Tuchel’s selection, with Ezri Konsa, Myles Lewis-Skelly and Eberechi Eze also included. Arteta said having an “English core”, and particularly an Arsenal connection, was vital for him.

“There is something that has to be within you, in your veins, in your roots,” the manager said. “When you are from here, you are so attached because we signed some players as well that they are already Arsenal supporters since they were kids and that has a different meaning. You can become one, which is great, and we have a few of them, but when it’s already there in your DNA it’s even more powerful and for me that’s very, very important.” Ed Aarons
Andoni Iraola has insisted Alisson is not solely responsible for Liverpool’s recent defensive lapses and wants the 34-year-old to extend his outstanding Anfield career beyond this season.

The Liverpool goalkeeper erred in the buildup to Arsenal’s winner in the Premier League last Sunday and was part of an unconvincing defensive display in the midweek Champions League defeat at Fenerbahce. Iraola, however, has defended Alisson amid rare criticism of his performances and insisted the two losses stemmed from collective failings rather than any individual.

“We’ve conceded goals in the last week against Arsenal and Fenerbahce where it is difficult to blame just one player, especially the Fenerbahce goals,” said the Liverpool head coach. “They were messy situations, especially the deflection off Cody Gakpo for the second goal.

“There have been more players involved than just Alisson. Even in the Arsenal goal, it’s true that we messed up in the goal-kick. I assume part of that because I am the one who is telling them to play it. But even after we lose the ball we have eight defenders behind the ball, so Ali is not the one more responsible for those goals.”

Alisson had got away with similar risky passes against Fulham and Brighton before being punished by Kai Havertz at the weekend, but Iraola does not want the Liverpool keeper to change his style. “We try to help the players identify when the situation is clear enough to play those kind of balls on our edge, or when the press is so aggressive that we should go more direct,” he explained. “Obviously we are going to make some mistakes in this process.”

Alisson is in the final eight months of his Liverpool contract, along with Virgil van Dijk, the captain, with no sign of an extension. Asked whether he expects this to be his final season at Anfield, Iraola replied: “I don’t know, that is a question you have to ask him. I hope not, I hope he continues with us for more time but, when you ask me about contracts and these situations, it is a matter for the players and the club.” Andy Hunter

Michael Carrick has revealed Carlos Baleba will be out for weeks with the hamstring injury the Manchester United midfielder sustained in Tuesday’s 3-2 victory over Roma. Baleba’s absence is a considerable blow to Carrick as he attempts to turn around United’s form and results.

The 22-year-old Cameroonian was signed from Brighton in the summer for £70m and had made a promising start. But before Tuesday’s injury he had managed only seven appearances, the first on 10 October, after recovering from an ankle problem he had when he joined. “It’ll be a number of weeks,” Carrick said of Baleba’s time out. “It’s definitely not this week and it won’t be any time over the international break. It’ll be a little bit longer than that.”

Carrick also gave an update on Patrick Dorgu, who has been unavailable since sustaining a hamstring problem with Denmark during the last international break. “He trained with us at the start of the week, so we’ve got to be patient with Pat,” said Carrick. “He’s had a good period of time now with a couple of hamstrings that we need to manage. But he’s slowly getting back with us, so we’ll have to see whether he can be involved at the weekend.”

Friday marked the 40th anniversary of Alex Ferguson’s appointment as United manager. As he prepared for Sunday’s visit of Aston Villa, Carrick was asked whether it was possible for him to reach the standards achieved by Ferguson at Old Trafford. United are 17th, separated from the relegation zone by goal difference.

“It’s not impossible,” said Carrick. “Anything’s possible. You’ve got to build, you’ve got to be realistic. You’ve got to put things in perspective as well, [with] the recent history that we’ve had and where we want to get to. It’s not going to happen in a blink of an eye. Success does take time, and we don’t like having to spend time, but it does take a period of time to build.” Jamie Jackson

Gianluigi Donnarumma has been backed by Enzo Maresca to rediscover his best form after high-profile mistakes in recent games. The Manchester City goalkeeper has made three errors leading to goals this season, notably at RB Leipzig on Wednesday when he was badly caught out of position.

Donnarumma will keep his place when City travel to Nottingham Forest on Saturday evening, aiming to end a run of two Premier League defeats in a row. The hosts are yet to score at home and sit second bottom.

“Overall he’s good,” Maresca said of his Italian compatriot. “He’s quite relaxed, in terms of he recognises that he has done some mistakes but at the same time, as I said after the last game, also he has made some good saves. So it’s just a matter of balance, try to avoid mistakes and continue to do the right things.”

Donnarumma’s position is not under threat from his deputy, Gerónimo Rulli. “There are players that when they make some mistake you need a conversation with them, and there are players that when they make some mistake you just need eye contact to understand that he recognises, he knows,” Maresca said. “With Gigio it’s quite easy because every time he has made some mistake or something that was not correct, he recognises immediately. I spoke with Gigio, but again sometimes you don’t need to be so deep with some players.”
Nico O’Reilly is available but was left out of the England squad on Friday because he is not fully fit. The left-back will have treatment over the next fortnight for a back problem. Will Unwin
Unai Emery has confirmed he has held talks over signing a new contract with a view to building a “stronger” project at Aston Villa.

On Wednesday, the day after Villa’s 3-0 Champions League defeat at Barcelona, the club said they had held a meeting to discuss their long-term strategy beyond 2029, when Emery’s deal is due to expire.
The manager been linked with several clubs, including Manchester United, but was involved with long-term talks, including with the chair, Nassef Sawiris.

Emery said: “My ambition is to keep our consistency and how we are improving and building lots of things positively. It is a huge challenge. They decided, speaking with us last year, to build a new stand to add more supporters at Villa Park. That is a clear step forward to get better.

“How we are increasing our budget each year, and revenue through our performance by playing in Europe and improving players, selling players, then buying young talented players, this is the process and ambition we should keep in the future.

“I had a good meeting with Nassef Sawiris, very good meeting, very positive. Let’s talk next week, trying to get everything we spoke about together. We were speaking about how we can set our project stronger with a deal, yes.” PA

items.titleZh: 英超新闻：阿尔特塔坚称赖斯并未过度疲劳
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳主帅阿尔特塔表示球队对赖斯照顾有加，并否认球员出场过多。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔为阿森纳使用德克兰·赖斯的方式进行了辩护，并坚称他们“比以往任何一个赛季都更加照顾他”。
赖斯在九月份退出了英格兰代表团，但在周三欧冠客场战胜布拉格斯拉维亚的下半场出现疲劳迹象后，这位中场球员在周五依然入选了托马斯·图赫尔的英格兰大名单。这位27岁的球员曾在世界杯期间受到长期背部和腿筋问题的困扰，在联赛杯阿森纳点球大战负于弗利特伍德的比赛中得到了轮休，此前他参加了每一场英超和欧冠比赛。
“有担忧吗？”阿尔特塔说。“在这个阵容中，哪位球员是唯一一个在联赛杯两场比赛中都被排除在阵容之外的？在家休息两天。这就是我的担忧。”
“（赖斯被过度使用的说法）这不是真的。我们比以往任何一个赛季都更加照顾他。他的训练方式以及所有的关爱。就是这样。这家足球俱乐部有这样的要求，而你拥有像他这样的球员。不仅是他，还有许多其他球员的出场时间甚至更少。就是这样。这必须是你的心态。如果你的大脑开始去想别的事情，就会造成损害。把它们抹掉，扔进垃圾桶，专注于你必须做的事情。”
本·怀特自世界杯前以来首次重返英格兰代表团，这意味着阿森纳球员占了图赫尔大名单的五分之一，埃兹里·孔萨、迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利和埃贝雷奇·埃泽也一同入选。阿尔特塔表示，拥有一个“英格兰核心”，特别是与阿森纳有联系的核心，对他是至关重要的。
“有些东西必须存在于你的体内、你的血管里、你的根基中，”主帅说道。“当你来自这里时，你是如此地依恋，因为我们也签下了一些从小就是阿森纳球迷的球员，这有着不同的意义。你可以成为其中一员，这很好，我们也有这样的人，但当它已经存在于你的DNA中时，它就更加强大了，对我来说这非常非常重要。”
安多尼·伊劳拉坚称阿利松并不是利物浦近期防线漏洞的唯一责任人，并希望这位34岁的球员能将他在安菲尔德的出色职业生涯延续到本赛季之后。
这位利物浦门将上周日在家门口对阵阿森纳的英超联赛中，在丢球过程中出现失误，并且在周中欧冠客场输给费内巴切的比赛中，其防守表现也难以令人信服。然而，在面对罕见的对其表现的批评时，伊劳拉为阿利松进行了辩护，并坚称这两场失利源于整体的失误，而不是某个人。
“我们在过去一周对阵阿森纳和费内巴切的比赛中丢了球，很难把责任归咎于某一个球员，尤其是对阵费内巴切时的失球，”利物浦主帅说道。“那是很混乱的情况，尤其是第二个球折射到了科迪·加克波身上。”
“参与其中的球员不仅是阿利松。甚至在对阵阿森纳的失球中，我们在球门球的处理上确实搞砸了。我承担一部分责任，因为是我告诉他们这样传球的。但即使在我们丢球之后，我们也有八名防守球员在球后，所以阿利松并不是对这些失球负有最大责任的人。”
阿利松此前在对阵富勒姆和布赖顿的比赛中也有过类似的高风险传球并侥幸过关，直到上周末被凯·哈弗茨惩罚，但伊劳拉并不希望这位利物浦门将改变自己的风格。“我们试图帮助球员识别什么时候情况足够明朗，可以在我们的禁区边缘打出这种球，或者什么时候对手的逼抢如此凶猛，以至于我们应该打得更直接一些，”他解释道。“显然我们在这一过程中会犯一些错误。”
阿利松与队长范戴克一样，目前正处于利物浦合同的最后八个月，且没有续约迹象。当被问及这是否会是他安菲尔德生涯的最后一个赛季时，伊劳拉回答说：“我不知道，这是你必须去问他的问题。我希望不是，我希望他能和我们在一起更长时间，但是当你们问我关于合同和这些情况时，这是球员和俱乐部的事。”
迈克尔·卡里克透露，曼联中场卡洛斯·巴勒巴在周二3-2战胜罗马的比赛中遭遇腿筋受伤，将缺阵数周。在卡里克试图扭转曼联的状态和战绩之际，巴勒巴的缺阵是一个沉重的打击。
这位22岁的喀麦隆球员在夏天以7000万英镑从布赖顿加盟，并有着一个充满希望的开局。但在周二受伤之前，他在10月10日迎来首秀后仅出场了7次，此前他一直在从加盟时带有的脚踝问题中恢复。“这将需要数周时间，”卡里克在谈到巴勒巴的缺阵时间时说。“这绝对不是这周，也不会是在国际比赛日期间的任何时候。会比那更久一点。”
卡里克还提供了帕特里克·多尔古的最新情况，他在上次国际比赛日随丹麦队比赛时遭遇腿筋问题，一直无法出场。“他在本周初和我们一起训练了，所以我们对帕特必须有耐心，”卡里克说。“经历了一段长时间处理两次腿筋问题后，他现在状态不错。但他正在慢慢回到我们身边，所以我们得看看他是否能在周末上场。”
周五是亚历克斯·弗格森被任命为曼联主帅的40周年纪念日。在备受周日主场对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛之际，卡里克被问及他是否有可能达到弗格森在老特拉福德取得的标准。曼联目前排名第17位，仅靠净胜球与降级区保持距离。
“这并非不可能，”卡里克说。“一切皆有可能。你必须建设，你必须现实。你还必须客看待问题，（结合）我们最近的历史以及我们想要达到的目标。这不会在眨眼之间发生。成功确实需要时间，我们虽然不喜欢花费时间，但建设确实需要一段时间。”
吉安路易吉·多纳鲁马近期在比赛中出现高调失误后，得到了恩佐·马雷斯卡的公开支持，以帮助他找回最佳状态。这位曼城门将本赛季已经出现3次直接导致失球的失误，尤其是在周三客场对阵RB莱比锡时因站位严重失误而丢球。
周六晚间曼城客场对阵诺丁汉森林时，多纳鲁马将保留其首发位置，旨在结束英超两连败的颓势。主队目前在主场尚未取得进球，排名倒数第二。
马雷斯卡在谈到这位意大利同胞时表示：“总体来说他很好。他相当放松，因为他意识到自己犯了一些错误，但与此同时，正如我在上一场比赛后所说，他也做出了一些精彩的扑救。所以这只是一个平衡的问题，尽量避免错误，继续做正确的事情。”
多纳鲁马的位置并没有受到替补门将赫罗尼莫·鲁利（Gerónimo Rulli）的威胁。“有些球员在犯错时你需要和他们谈谈，而有些球员在犯错时你只需要一个眼神交流就能明白他已经认识到了、他心里清楚，”马雷斯卡说。“对于吉吉（Gigio）来说这很简单，因为每次他犯了错误或做了不正确的事情时，他都会立即意识到。我和吉吉谈过，但话说回来，有时你不需要和某些球员谈得太深。”
尼科·奥赖利身体可用，但在周五因身体未完全恢复而被排除在英格兰代表团之外。这位左后卫将在接下来的两周内接受背部问题的治疗。
乌奈·埃梅利已确认他已就签下一份新合同进行了会谈，旨在阿斯顿维拉构建一个“更强大”的计划。
周三，即维拉在欧冠客场0-3不敌巴塞罗那的第二天，俱乐部表示他们曾召开会议，讨论2029年埃梅里合同到期后的长期战略。
这位主帅与包括曼联在内的几家俱乐部联系在一起，但他一直参与长期会谈，包括与俱乐部主席纳塞夫·萨维里斯（Nassef Sawiris）的交流。
埃梅里说：“我的雄心是保持我们的稳定性，看我们如何改进并在许多方面积极地进行建设。这是一个巨大的挑战。去年他们与我们讨论后决定建造一个新的看台，以便在维拉公园容纳更多球迷。这是变得更好的明确一步。”
“我们如何每年增加预算，以及通过参加欧洲赛事和培养球员、出售球员然后购买年轻天才球员来提高收入，这是我们未来应该保持的过程和雄心。”
“我和纳塞夫·萨维里斯开了一场好会，非常好的会，非常积极。我们下周再谈，争取把我们讨论过的事情都落实下来。我们一直在讨论我们如何通过一份协议让我们的项目变得更强大，是的。”

bodyEn: Nothing better encapsulates the dysfunction that was Everton under Farhad Moshiri than the idea that an unknown vandal with a can of spray paint could influence the club’s managerial direction. “Pereira out, Lampard in” they daubed on a wall at Goodison Park when it appeared Vítor Pereira was in line to replace Rafael Benítez in 2022. Alarmed by fan protests, the Everton board opted instead for Frank Lampard and, while his tenure ended 12 months later with the club immersed in another relegation battle, there will be appreciation for the Coventry manager when he makes a first visit to Hill Dickinson Stadium on Friday. The connection between Lampard and Evertonians was genuine and a factor in keeping the club up in 2022. Both parties will be glad to see the other emerging stronger from those troubled times. Jack Grealish, meanwhile, will again be absent for Everton after his recent disciplinary breach, although the manager, David Moyes, said: “We will be working again with Jack soon.” Andy Hunter
Everton v Coventry City, Friday 8pm (all times GMT)

Back in September, when Leeds thrashed Newcastle 4-1 at Elland Road, talk of European qualification filled the West Yorkshire airwaves. Since then Daniel Farke’s side have drawn three and lost two of their ensuing Premier League games, scoring just two goals along the way. Given that their final pass has persistently let them down, optimism is turning to pessimism. Farke would call it realism. The German – who could probably do without facing Roberto De Zerbi’s improving Tottenham on Saturday – is confident his side are making progress but knows they cannot expect to run before properly mastering the art of walking. “We don’t have the individual quality [of the Premier League’s leading teams],” said Farke on Thursday. “We have to compensate by being tactically spot on and good at winning second balls. It’s not a criticism of my players, it’s reality. The dream of Europe is allowed but we know our main aim is to reach 40 points as quickly as possible.” Louise Taylor
Leeds v Tottenham, Saturday 12.30pm

Martín Zubimendi has yet to start a Premier League game this season after falling down the pecking order at Arsenal and the Spain midfielder is likely to be the subject of speculation that he could seek to depart in January. The emergence of Myles Lewis-Skelly as an alternative in the No 6 position at the end of last season has had an impact on Zubimendi after he had been a regular starter for most of his debut campaign in the Premier League. The 27-year-old signed from Real Sociedad for around £55m 15 months ago and Mikel Arteta has insisted he remains an integral part of his plans. But with the Arsenal manager trying to find the right balance in his midfield after the arrival of Bruno Guimarães, Zubimendi will be hoping he gets another chance to stake his claim against Hull on Saturday after starting in the narrow win over Slavia Prague in midweek. Ed Aarons
Arsenal v Hull City, Saturday 3pm

Álvaro Arbeloa is proof that a struggling young manager working in England for the first time can bounce back after a difficult start. Arbeloa was sliding towards the sack a month ago but he has responded at Fulham, who have taken seven points from their last three games, and will hope to extend the unbeaten run when Matthias Jaissle’s inconsistent Newcastle visit Craven Cottage. It is an inviting fixture for Fulham and a big one for Newcastle, who were poor when they lost to Everton on Monday. Jaissle, hired as Eddie Howe’s replacement in the summer, is already under pressure. But the 38-year-old could take inspiration from how Arbeloa has given himself breathing space at Fulham. Jacob Steinberg
Fulham v Newcastle, Saturday 3pm

Oliver Glasner has previous. He led Wolfsburg from mid-table to the Champions League but fell out with the club hierarchy and left in 2021. Glasner next guided Eintracht Frankfurt to Europa League glory but was openly critical of the squad’s imbalance and quality in four separate outbursts and departed in 2023. His time at Crystal Palace was a great success but after accusing the Eagles’ board in January of “abandoning” his team with the sale of Marc Guéhi to Manchester City, the Austrian left this summer for Nottingham Forest, where he became the fifth head coach in less than a year. You can probably guess where this is going. After Saturday’s defeat by Brentford left Forest 19th, Glasner was typically abrasive: “If the players buy in [to my methods], I think we can have a turnaround. And if not, the sixth manager will come in.” We’ll soon find out if Glasner has won the players around with City visiting Nottingham this weekend. If Forest’s woeful form continues, Glasner may either walk or get his marching orders from trigger-happy owner Evangelos Marinakis. Michael Butler
Nottingham Forest v Manchester City, 5.30pm

Pierre Sage pulled no punches in his assessment of Eddie Nketiah’s career after his excellent winning goal against Fulham last week in the EFL Cup. “I think his potential is higher than his performance for the moment,” said the Crystal Palace manager. “And we have to reduce this gap – because he needs it, the team needs it.” Nketiah is now 27 and won his solitary senior cap for England in 2023 after becoming the record scorer for the under-21s while he was still at Arsenal. His chances of adding to that look unlikely these days having been relegated to third-choice striker at Selhurst Park behind Jean-Philippe Mateta and Jørgen Strand Larsen. But with Mateta suspended for three matches after Palace’s appeal over his red card against Tottenham was rejected, Sunday’s meeting with Liverpool could be another chance for Nketiah to show his ability after scoring a late winner against them in Palace’s thrilling win over Arne Slot’s side last year. EA

after newsletter promotion
Crystal Palace v Liverpool, Sunday 2pm

It has been three weeks since Brighton’s fans were savouring a famous 5-0 thrashing of arch-rivals Crystal Palace at the Amex. But the quirks of the fixture list meant that Fabian Hürzeler’s side played five successive games on the road since then, including two trips to face Manchester City. While they lost some of the momentum from the Palace victory in the defeat by Liverpool at Anfield, last week’s Premier League win over City showed they are serious contenders for the top four and perhaps even more. But Brentford’s visit to the south coast should provide a real test of those credentials as the owner, Tony Bloom, renews his rivalry with his west London counterpart Matthew Benham, who traditionally eschews his seat in the directors’ box for one in the away section. EA
Brighton v Brentford, Sunday 2pm

Eli Junior Kroupi did not take the headlines in Bournemouth’s win over Leeds but his cheeky nutmeg and sumptuous no-look pass to set up Amine Adli for the Cherries’ second goal was a reminder of why the youngster continues to be linked with a move to Arsenal, Bayern and PSG, despite being sidelined recently. Kroupi scored 13 Premier League goals last season – only Ryan Giggs, Wayne Rooney, Michael Owen and Romelu Lukaku have reached that total as teenagers – and only Erling Haaland and Will Osula enjoyed a better goal-per-game ratio in 2025-26. Kroupi’s foot injury, sustained in pre-season, has been carefully managed but after three substitute appearances in the wins over Manchester United, Aston Villa and Leeds, will Marco Rose be tempted to start Kroupi at Ipswich? Evanilson is in red hot form as the central striker but Kroupi is just as comfortable as a No 10 and surely has to play if he is fit as Bournemouth chase a seventh consecutive win in all competitions. MB
Ipswich v Bournemouth, Sunday 2pm

It is not quite six months since Sunderland beat Chelsea 2-1 at the Stadium of Light and qualified for Europe for the first time in 53 years. A day when Régis Le Bris’s side eclipsed the Club World Cup holders and Enzo Le Fée upstaged Enzo Fernández concluded with Sunderland finishing seventh. During the prolonged post-match celebrations, the captain, Granit Xhaka, grabbed a microphone and declared: “This is just the beginning – we want more.” Fast forward to gloomy November and it is not quite working out like that with even the excitement of next month’s trip to Milan overshadowed by anxiety. Sunderland are bottom of the Premier League, Le Bris concedes his side are in a relegation fight and Xhaka has looked a shadow of his former self ever since Chelsea tried and failed to sign him in the summer. Is Xhaka capable of turning back time? Sunderland securing just a second league win of the season depends on it. Louise Taylor
Sunderland v Chelsea, Sunday 2pm

Can Manchester United win two games of football on the bounce for the first time this season? Being able to pose this question sums up the state Michael Carrick and his side are in as they seek to build on Tuesday’s chaotic comeback victory over Roma. Aston Villa arrive five points better off than their hosts and are everything United are not: stable, upwardly mobile and boasting a manager in Unai Emery who consistently improves players and yields results. As the international break beckons after this last Premier League fixture of the weekend, will Carrick survive what could be an eighth loss in 15 matches? Possibly, if it is not another humiliation, but the truth may be that even United’s erratic executives do not currently know the answer. Jamie Jackson
Manchester United v Aston Villa, Sunday 4.30pm

items.titleZh: 英超周末看点：阿森纳迎战赫尔城，祖比门迪渴望证明自己
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点了本轮英超的十大看点，其中包含阿森纳对阵赫尔城以及祖比门迪的相关情况。
bodyZh: 没有什么比法哈德·莫西里时代的埃弗顿更能体现其混乱管理了，一个带着喷漆罐的未知涂鸦者居然能影响俱乐部的帅位走向。2022年，当维托·佩雷拉有望接替拉法·贝尼特斯时，古迪逊公园球场的墙上被刷上了“佩雷拉下课，兰帕德上课”。埃弗顿董事会惊慌失措于球迷的抗议，最终选择了弗兰克·兰帕德。虽然12个月后他的任期在球队再次陷入保级战时结束，但周五他首次造访希尔迪金森体育场时，仍会受到考文垂主帅应有的赞赏。兰帕德与埃弗顿球迷之间的联系是真挚的，这也是2022年球队保级成功的一个因素。双方都会高兴地看到彼此从那些艰难岁月中以更强的姿态走出。与此同时，在经历了近期的纪律处分后，杰克·格拉利什将再次缺席埃弗顿的比赛，不过主教练大卫·莫伊斯表示：“我们很快将再次与杰克合作。” 安迪·亨特
埃弗顿对阵考文垂，周五晚上8点（所有时间均为格林威治标准时间）

早在9月份利兹联在埃兰路球场4-1大胜纽卡斯尔时，西约克郡的空气中就充满了关于进球欧战资格的讨论。自那以后，丹尼尔·法尔克的球队在随后的英超比赛中取得三平两负，期间仅攻入两球。鉴于他们的最后一传屡屡掉链子，乐观情绪正在转向悲观。法尔克会称之为现实主义。这位德国教练——在周六或许本可以不用面对罗伯托·德泽尔比不断进步的热刺——坚信他的球队正在取得进步，但也明白在真正掌握步行艺术之前，他们不能指望跑步。“我们没有（英超领先球队的）个人实力，”法尔克周四说道，“我们必须通过战术完全到位和擅长争抢第二落点来进行弥补。这不是对我的球员的批评，这是现实。欧战的梦想是被允许的，但我们知道我们的主要目标是尽快达到40分。” 路易斯·泰勒
利兹联对阵热刺，周六下午12点30分

马丁·祖比门迪本赛季在阿森纳逐渐失宠，尚未在英超联赛中首发过一场比赛，这位西班牙中场很可能成为1月份寻求离队传闻的主角。上赛季末迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利在6号位上的崛起，对祖比门迪产生了影响，而在此之前，他在英超处女赛季的大部分时间里都是常规首发。这位27岁的球员在15个月前以约5500万英镑的价格从皇家社会加盟，米克尔·阿尔特塔坚信他仍然是其计划中不可或缺的一部分。但随着阿森纳主帅在布鲁诺·吉马良斯加盟后努力寻找中场平衡，祖比门迪希望在周六对阵赫尔城的比赛中获得另一个证明自己的机会，此前他在周中对阵布拉格斯拉维亚的险胜中首发出场。 埃德·阿伦斯
阿森纳对阵赫尔城，周六下午3点

阿尔瓦罗·阿韦罗亚证明了一位在英格兰首次执教的年轻主帅在经历艰难开局后能够反弹。阿韦罗亚一个月前还在下课的边缘挣扎，但在富勒姆他做出了回应，最近三场比赛取得了七分，并将希望在马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯勒状态起伏的纽卡斯尔造访克拉伦农场时延续不败战绩。对于富勒姆来说这是一个诱人的赛程，对于周一输给埃弗顿表现糟糕的纽卡斯尔来说则是一场大战。在夏天被聘为埃迪·豪接替者的贾伊斯勒已经面临压力。但这位38岁的教练可以从阿韦罗亚如何在富勒姆为自己赢得喘息空间中获得灵感。 雅各布·斯坦伯格
富勒姆对阵纽卡斯尔，周六下午3点

奥利弗·格拉斯纳有前科。他曾率领沃尔夫斯堡从中游带到欧冠，但与俱乐部高层不和并在2021年离任。格拉斯纳随后带领法兰克福夺得欧联杯冠军，但在四次不同的爆发中公开批评阵容的失衡与质量，并于2023年离任。他在水晶宫的执期非常成功，但在今年1月指责老鹰队董事会在将马克·格伊卖给曼城时“抛弃”了他的球队后，这位奥地利人今年夏天转投诺丁汉森林，成为了不到一年内的第五任主教练。你大概能猜到事情会发展成什么样。在周六输给布伦特福德导致森林队排名降至第19位之后，格拉斯纳一如既往地尖锐：“如果球员们买账（我的方法），我认为我们可以扭转局面。如果不是，第六个教练就要来了。”我们很快就会看到曼城本周末造访诺丁汉时，格拉斯纳是否赢得了球员的支持。如果森林队糟糕的状态继续下去，格拉斯纳可能会主动辞职，或者被急功近利的业主埃万杰洛斯·马里纳基斯解雇。 迈克尔·巴特勒
诺丁汉森林对阵曼城，下午5点30分

皮埃尔·萨奇在上周联赛杯对阵富勒姆的比赛中打入精彩绝杀后，对埃迪·恩凯蒂亚的职业生涯评估毫不留情。“我认为他目前的潜力高于他的表现，”水晶宫主教练说，“我们必须缩小这个差距——因为他需要，球队也需要。”恩凯蒂亚现在27岁，在效力阿森纳期间成为U21国青队的射手王后，于2023年完成了他唯一的英格兰成年国家队首秀。如今，随着他在塞尔赫斯特公园沦为让-菲利普·马特塔和约尔根·斯特兰·拉森之后的第三选择，他再次入选国家队的机会看起来不太可能。但由于马特塔因水晶宫对阵热刺红牌上诉被驳回而被禁赛三场，周日对阵利物浦的比赛可能是恩凯蒂亚展现自己能力的机会，他在去年水晶宫击败阿恩·斯洛特球队的惊险胜利中曾打入绝杀球。EA

距离布莱顿球迷在美洲球场品味5-0大胜死敌水晶宫的辉煌胜利已经过去三周了。但由于赛程的巧合，法比安·许策尔的球队此后连续进行了五场客场比赛，其中包括两次客场挑战曼城。虽然他们在输给利物浦的比赛中失去了一些击败水晶宫的势头，但上周在英超中击败曼城的比赛表明他们是前四名甚至更高的有力争夺者。不过布伦特福德对南海岸的造访将是对这些资格的一次真正的考验，因为老板托尼·布鲁姆将与西伦敦同行马修·本汉重燃宿敌之战，后者传统上会放弃董事包厢的座位，转而坐在客场球迷看台。EA
布莱顿对阵布伦特福德，周日下午2点

埃利·儒尼奥尔·克鲁皮在伯恩茅斯战胜利兹联的比赛中并没有抢尽风头，但他那记巧妙的穿裆过人和精妙的无视传球助攻阿明·阿德利打进樱桃军团的第二球，提醒了人们为什么这位年轻人尽管近期一直在养伤，却依然继续与阿森纳、拜仁和巴黎圣日耳曼联系在一起。克鲁皮在上赛季打入了13个英超进球——在青少年时期达到这一进球总数的只有瑞恩·吉格斯、韦恩·鲁尼、迈克尔·欧文和罗梅卢·卢卡库——在2025-26赛季中，只有埃尔林·哈兰德和威尔·奥苏拉拥有更好的场均进球比率。克鲁皮在季前赛中遭受的脚伤一直受到小心翼翼的控制，但在对阵曼联、阿斯顿维拉和利兹联的胜利中三次替补登场后，马可·罗斯会经受住让克鲁皮在伊普斯维奇首发的诱惑吗？埃瓦尼尔森作为中锋状态火热，但克鲁皮同样胜任10号位，如果他身体健康，随着伯恩茅斯在各项赛事中追逐六连胜，他肯定得登场。MB
伊普斯维奇对阵伯恩茅斯，周日下午2点

距离桑德兰在光明球场2-1击败切尔西并时隔53年首次晋级欧战还不到六个月。那是雷吉斯·勒布里斯的球队击败世俱杯冠军、恩佐·勒费伊大放异彩压倒恩佐·费尔南德斯的一天，最终桑德兰以第七名结束了赛季。在长时间的赛后庆祝活动中，队长格兰特·扎卡抢过话筒宣布：“这只是个开始——我们想要更多。”快进到阴暗的11月，事情的发展并非如此，甚至连下个月前往米兰的兴奋也被焦虑所掩盖。桑德兰目前在英超垫底，勒布里斯承认球队正陷入保级战，而自从切尔西在夏天尝试签下他未果后，扎卡看起来就像是他过去自己的一个影子。扎卡有能力时光倒流吗？桑德兰能否取得本赛季的第二场联赛胜利全在此举。 路易斯·泰勒
桑德兰对阵切尔西，周日下午2点

曼联能本赛季首次取得联赛两连胜吗？能够提出这个问题，总结了迈克尔·卡里克及其球队在他们试图延续周二对阵罗马的混乱逆转胜利时的状态。阿斯顿维拉到来时比主队多积五分，他们拥有曼联所不具备的一切：稳定、积极向上，并且拥有一个能不断提升球员并带来成果的主帅埃梅里。随着周末最后一场英超比赛结束后国际比赛日的临近，卡里克能否在可能成为15场比赛中的第8场失利中幸存下来？如果这不是又一次羞辱，那是有可能的，但事实可能是，连曼联那些反复无常的高层目前也不知道答案。 杰米·杰克逊
曼联对阵阿斯顿维拉，周日下午4点30分

bodyEn: David Raya has said Arsenal are using the pain of losing on penalties against Paris Saint-Germain in last year’s Champions League final to “make it better this year”.

The Spain goalkeeper produced an outstanding save to help Arsenal hold off Slavia Prague on Wednesday as Mikel Arteta’s side moved up to third in the league standings with 10 points from four matches.

Arsenal will face Borussia Dortmund next at home this month before hosting Real Madrid on 9 December in a showdown that could be vital to their chances of finishing in the top two and ensuring the second leg of their first knockout tie and any that follow would be at the Emirates.

That was the case last season when Arsenal became the first team to win all eight league stage matches and made it to the final in Budapest. Raya has admitted he is haunted by that experience as PSG won back-to-back titles.

“I think it is never going to be out of the system,” he said. “It is something that is going to live with us and hopefully we can win the Champions League to get that out of us. But it has to be in our veins. It has to be on us to make it better this year.”

Raya came to Arsenal’s rescue as Slavia valiantly attempted to fight back from 2-0 down at the break. His diving stop to keep out Oskar Kubiak’s header helped to make it 10 away games in Europe without defeat. Raya, who missed out on the Yashin award for best goalkeeper at the Ballon d’Or to his Spain teammate Unai Simón, credited his self-belief as key to making extraordinary saves on a regular basis.

“Belief is really important but hard work [is, too],” he said. “I work very hard during the week to try and help the team as much as possible on these types of nights. That gives you that extra edge and motivation to keep doing it every single week, and the consistency I have been playing with throughout the years is a key factor for us.”

items.titleZh: 拉亚：欧冠决赛失利之痛已融入血液，我们要争取今年做得更好
items.summaryZh: 大卫·拉亚表示阿森纳正利用上赛季欧冠决赛失利的痛苦作为动力，力争今年做得更好。
bodyZh: 大卫·拉亚表示，阿森纳正利用去年在欧冠决赛中点球不敌巴黎圣日耳曼的痛苦，来“争取今年做得更好”。
这位西班牙门将周三做出了一次神勇扑救，帮助阿森纳挡住了布拉格斯拉维亚的反扑，在米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队前四场比赛拿到10分后，升至联赛积分榜第三位。
阿森纳本月接下来将在主场对阵多特蒙德，随后于12月9日主场迎战皇家马德里，这场对决对于他们争取前两名、确保首场淘汰赛及后续所有淘汰赛次回合在酋长球场进行至关重要。
上赛季正是如此，当时阿森纳成为第一支赢得全部八场联赛阶段比赛并杀入布达佩斯决赛的球队。随着巴黎圣日耳曼实现卫冕，拉亚坦言那段经历一直萦绕在他心头。
他说道：“我认为这永远不会消失。这将伴随着我们，希望我们能赢得欧冠来摆脱这种感觉。但这必须融入我们的血液。我们要靠自己去争取今年做得更好。”
当布拉格斯拉维亚在上半场以0-2落后奋力反扑时，拉亚挺身而出拯救了阿森纳。他飞身扑出奥斯卡·库比亚克的头球攻门，帮助球队实现了在欧洲客场10场不败。拉亚在金球奖最佳门将雅辛奖的争夺中输给了西班牙队友乌奈·西蒙，他认为自信是自己能够经常做出非凡扑救的关键。
